function out = ffd_sim(scen, p, plant, varargin)
%FFD_SIM 腿摆角前馈 + LQR 闭环仿真，逐 tick 复刻固件 Mature/Ctrl 分支
%
%   out = ffd_sim(scen, p, plant)
%
%   scen : ffd_scenarios() 里的一条工况，需含
%          .name, .T (s), .height (指令腿长 m), .v_cmd (函数句柄 t->m/s),
%          .x0 (可选, 10x1 初始状态)
%   p    : ffd_params() 返回的参数结构
%   plant: ffd_plant() 返回的被控对象/增益表
%
%   可选项:
%     'LegLenFrozen' (true)  被控对象/增益按 cmd_.height_f 取值。固件用的是实测
%                            腿长，但腿长环由独立 PID 跟踪 height_f 且本仿真不含
%                            五连杆，故用 height_f 近似。
%     'Trim' (false)         是否启用 theta_trim_ 慢积分(10s 量级，短工况里基本不动)
%
%   固件对应关系(chassis.cpp)：
%     updateLongitudinalTrajectory  -> local_update_traj
%     calcLegSwingFfd               -> local_leg_swing_ffd
%     pos hold / pos_authority_     -> 主循环内
%     applyLegSwingRefLimit         -> local_apply_ref_limit
%     calcLQROut                    -> local_lqr_out
%
%   状态与固件一致:
%     X = [pos dpos phi dphi theta_l dtheta_l theta_r dtheta_r theta_b dtheta_b]'
%     u = [T_w_l T_w_r T_b_l T_b_r]'

ip = inputParser;
ip.addParameter('LegLenFrozen', true, @islogical);
ip.addParameter('Trim', false, @islogical);
ip.addParameter('LegLenMode', 'proj', @(s) ismember(s, {'cmd', 'proj'}));
ip.parse(varargin{:});
opt = ip.Results;

dt = p.kCtrlPeriod;
n  = round(scen.T / dt);

% 精确几何模型。theta_req 里有 fzero，每 tick 求根太慢，故预先在 (h, a) 网格上
% 建插值表。h 用指令高度(工况内按 kMaxDH 斜坡，范围有限)，a 覆盖加减速上限。
geom = [];
if strcmp(p.FfdModel, 'exact')
    geom = ffd_geom_lut(p);
end

% 固件口径小公式(k/tau/theta_max/cog_height)整合在 ffd_fw 里，取一次复用
fw = ffd_fw(p);

%% ---- 状态初始化 (对应 MatureState::Init) ----
X = zeros(10, 1);
if isfield(scen, 'x0') && ~isempty(scen.x0)
    X = scen.x0(:);
end

% 轨迹状态 (LongitudinalTrajectory)
traj = struct('dpos_ref', X(2), 'requested_vel', 0, 'acc_cmd', 0, ...
              'effective_acc_limit', 0, 'phase', "Hold");

theta_ffd  = 0;
dtheta_ffd = 0;
theta_trim = 0;
demand_scale = 0;
gate_latched = false;
pos_authority = 1.0;
track_scale = 1.0;
pos_hold_active = false;
theta_b_ref = 0;

% 参考状态
ref = zeros(10, 1);
ref(1) = X(1);
ref(2) = X(2);

% cmd_.height_f 从初始腿长斜坡到指令腿长
height_f = scen.height;
if isfield(scen, 'height0') && ~isempty(scen.height0)
    height_f = scen.height0;
end

%% ---- 日志 ----
L = struct();
flds = {'t','pos','dpos','theta_l','dtheta_l','theta_b','dtheta_b','theta_fdb', ...
        'dpos_ref','acc_cmd','acc_limit','theta_ffd','dtheta_ffd','theta_ref', ...
        'theta_trim','demand','demand_scale','theta_max','pos_authority', ...
        'track_scale','pos_err','height_f','k_l','Tw','Tb','pos_hold', ...
        'requested_vel','braking'};
for i = 1:numel(flds)
    L.(flds{i}) = zeros(n, 1);
end

%% ---- 主循环 ----
for k = 1:n
    t = (k-1) * dt;

    % cmd_.height_f 斜坡 (chassis.cpp:2234)
    height_f = local_lim_diff(scen.height, height_f, p.kMaxDH, dt);
    height_f = min(max(height_f, p.kCmdHeightMin), p.kCmdHeightMax);

    % ---- 指令高度 h 与真实腿长 l 的区分 ----
    % cmd_.height_f 是髋关节的**垂直**高度 h。固件 chassis.cpp:2290 下发的是
    %     leg_ref_state_.height = cmd_.height_f / cos(theta)
    % 即真实的沿腿长度 l = h/cos(theta)，这么做正是为了摆腿时车身高度不变(车身平)。
    %
    % 而 LQR 增益表是按 leg_curr_state_.height 查的(lqrcontrol.cpp:94)，也就是
    % 按 l 查，不是按 h 查。摆到 30° 时 l/h = 1.155，查表位置差 15%，不能忽略。
    %   'proj' = 按 l = h/cos(theta) 查表，与固件一致(默认)
    %   'cmd'  = 按 h 查表，即旧版仿真的做法，留作对照
    theta_meas = (X(5) + X(7)) * 0.5;
    if strcmp(opt.LegLenMode, 'proj')
        leg_len = height_f / max(cos(theta_meas), 0.2);
    else
        leg_len = height_f;
    end
    leg_len = min(max(leg_len, p.kCmdHeightMin), p.kCmdHeightMax);
    h_eff = leg_len;

    K  = plant.getK(h_eff, h_eff);
    Ud = plant.getUd(h_eff, h_eff);
    [Ac, Bc] = plant.getAB(h_eff, h_eff);

    %% theta_b 参考 (chassis.cpp:5519)
    theta_b_ref = local_lim_diff(p.kThetaBodyBias, theta_b_ref, p.kPitchMaxDAng, dt);
    theta_b_ref = min(max(theta_b_ref, -0.2), 0.2);
    ref(9)  = theta_b_ref;
    ref(10) = 0;

    %% 大摆角降权 updateLegSwingTrackScale (chassis.cpp:925)
    raw_scale = 1 - local_smoothstep01( ...
        (max(abs(X(5)), abs(X(7))) - p.kLegSwingTrackStartTheta) / ...
        (p.kLegSwingTrackStopTheta - p.kLegSwingTrackStartTheta));
    rate = p.kLegSwingTrackScaleUpRate;
    if raw_scale < track_scale
        rate = p.kLegSwingTrackScaleDownRate;
    end
    track_scale = local_lim_diff(raw_scale, track_scale, rate, dt);
    if track_scale < p.kLegSwingTrackScaleEps
        track_scale = 0;
    end

    %% 速度指令 (chassis.cpp:5551)
    v_cmd = scen.v_cmd(t);
    speed_limit = p.kMaxMovingSpeed;
    requested_speed = v_cmd * track_scale;
    requested_speed = min(max(requested_speed, -speed_limit), speed_limit);

    %% updateLongitudinalTrajectory
    traj = local_update_traj(traj, requested_speed, speed_limit, height_f, p, dt);
    ref(2) = min(max(traj.dpos_ref, -speed_limit), speed_limit);

    %% calcLegSwingFfd
    % 前馈的腿长参数一律用**指令**高度 height_f，不用实测 l：指令量只与操作
    % 意图相关，不会被摆角自身污染，否则 theta -> l -> k(l) -> theta 成环。
    [theta_ffd, dtheta_ffd, demand_scale, theta_max, k_l, gate_latched] = ...
        local_leg_swing_ffd(theta_ffd, height_f, traj, X(2), p, dt, geom, fw, gate_latched);

    % 总钳位留 theta_trim_ 余量 (chassis.cpp:5623)
    theta_cmd_max = fw.theta_max(height_f) + p.kThetaTrimMax;
    theta_cmd = min(max(theta_ffd + theta_trim, -theta_cmd_max), theta_cmd_max);
    ref(5) = theta_cmd;  ref(6) = dtheta_ffd;
    ref(7) = theta_cmd;  ref(8) = dtheta_ffd;

    %% 位置锁定 / pos_authority_ (chassis.cpp:5634)
    braking = strcmp(traj.phase, "BrakeToHold") || strcmp(traj.phase, "BrakeToReverse");
    zero_input = abs(traj.requested_vel) <= p.kCmdMovingVelEps;
    avg_theta = (X(5) + X(7)) * 0.5;
    enter_pos_hold = zero_input && abs(X(2)) < p.kLongTrajPosHoldEnterSpeed && ...
                     abs(avg_theta) < p.kPosHoldEnterTheta;
    if ~zero_input
        pos_hold_active = false;
    end

    if enter_pos_hold && ~pos_hold_active
        ref(1) = X(1);                 % reanchorLongitudinalPosition
        pos_hold_active = true;
    elseif braking && ~pos_hold_active
        ref(1) = X(1);
    elseif abs(ref(2)) > p.kCmdMovingVelEps
        ref(1) = ref(1) + ref(2) * dt;
    end
    ref(1) = min(max(ref(1), X(1) - p.kAirPosMaxBias), X(1) + p.kAirPosMaxBias);

    release_pos_authority = braking && ~pos_hold_active;
    if release_pos_authority
        pos_authority = local_lim_diff(0, pos_authority, p.kPosAuthorityDownRate, dt);
    else
        pos_authority = local_lim_diff(1, pos_authority, p.kPosAuthorityUpRate, dt);
    end

    %% updateThetaTrim (chassis.cpp:1033)
    if opt.Trim && pos_hold_active
        theta_trim = theta_trim + p.kThetaTrimKi * (ref(1) - X(1)) * dt;
        theta_trim = min(max(theta_trim, -p.kThetaTrimMax), p.kThetaTrimMax);
    end

    %% applyLegSwingRefLimit (chassis.cpp:945)
    pos_err_raw = ref(1) - X(1);
    ref_eff = ref;
    ref_eff(1) = X(1) + track_scale * pos_authority * pos_err_raw;
    ref_eff(3) = X(3) + track_scale * (ref(3) - X(3));
    ref_eff(4) = ref(4) * track_scale;

    %% calcLQROut (lqrcontrol.cpp:596)
    u = local_lqr_out(K, Ud, ref_eff, X, p);

    % 执行器饱和：轮毂 ±kWheelMaxTq，关节 ±kJointMaxTq
    u(1:2) = min(max(u(1:2), -p.kWheelMaxTq), p.kWheelMaxTq);
    u(3:4) = min(max(u(3:4), -p.kJointMaxTq), p.kJointMaxTq);

    %% 记录
    L.t(k) = t;
    L.pos(k) = X(1);          L.dpos(k) = X(2);
    L.theta_l(k) = X(5);      L.dtheta_l(k) = X(6);
    L.theta_b(k) = X(9);      L.dtheta_b(k) = X(10);
    L.theta_fdb(k) = avg_theta;
    L.dpos_ref(k) = ref(2);   L.acc_cmd(k) = traj.acc_cmd;
    L.acc_limit(k) = traj.effective_acc_limit;
    L.theta_ffd(k) = theta_ffd;  L.dtheta_ffd(k) = dtheta_ffd;
    L.theta_ref(k) = theta_cmd;  L.theta_trim(k) = theta_trim;
    L.demand(k) = abs(traj.requested_vel - X(2));
    L.demand_scale(k) = demand_scale;
    L.theta_max(k) = theta_max;
    L.pos_authority(k) = pos_authority;
    L.track_scale(k) = track_scale;
    L.pos_err(k) = pos_err_raw;
    L.height_f(k) = height_f;
    L.k_l(k) = k_l;
    L.Tw(k) = u(1);  L.Tb(k) = u(3);
    L.pos_hold(k) = double(pos_hold_active);
    L.requested_vel(k) = traj.requested_vel;
    L.braking(k) = double(braking);

    %% 积分：连续模型 + 零阶保持，一步 RK4
    f = @(x) Ac * x + Bc * u;
    k1 = f(X);
    k2 = f(X + 0.5*dt*k1);
    k3 = f(X + 0.5*dt*k2);
    k4 = f(X + dt*k3);
    X = X + (dt/6) * (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4);

    if any(~isfinite(X)) || abs(X(9)) > pi/2
        % 机体倒下，截断日志
        for i = 1:numel(flds)
            L.(flds{i}) = L.(flds{i})(1:k);
        end
        out = local_pack(L, scen, p, plant, true);
        return;
    end
end

out = local_pack(L, scen, p, plant, false);
end

% ================================================================ 固件函数

function y = local_lim_diff(ref_v, curr_v, max_diff, dt)
% tool.hpp:201 LimDiff
d = ref_v - curr_v;
m = max_diff * dt;
d = min(max(d, -m), m);
y = curr_v + d;
end

function y = local_smoothstep01(x)
% chassis.hpp:867
x = min(max(x, 0), 1);
y = x * x * (3 - 2 * x);
end

function [s, latched] = local_demand_scale(requested_vel, curr_vel, p, latched)
% chassis.hpp CalcThetaFfdDemandScale，带施密特滞回
demand = abs(requested_vel - curr_vel);
if ~latched
    if demand < p.kThetaFfdDemandEnter
        s = 0;
        return;
    end
    latched = true;
elseif demand <= p.kThetaFfdDemandDeadband
    latched = false;
end
full = p.kMaxMovingSpeed * p.kThetaFfdDemandFullRatio;
span = full - p.kThetaFfdDemandDeadband;
if span <= 1e-6
    s = 1;
    return;
end
s = min(max((demand - p.kThetaFfdDemandDeadband) / span, 0), 1);
end

function a = local_dynamic_acc(curr_vel, max_vel, max_acc)
% chassis.hpp CalcDynamicCmdMovingAcc
ratio_min = 0.8;
bounded = max(max_vel, 1e-6);
vr = min(max(abs(curr_vel) / bounded, 0), 1);
a_min = max_acc * ratio_min;
a = a_min + (max_acc - a_min) * cos(pi * 0.5 * vr);
a = min(max(a, a_min), max_acc);
end

function a = local_leglen_acc(height, p, decel)
% chassis.hpp CalcLegLengthScaledMaxCmdMovingAcc / ...DecAcc
h_low = p.kFlightHeight - 0.03;
if decel
    a_low = p.kMaxCmdMovingDecAcc;
else
    a_low = p.kMaxCmdMovingAcc;
end
a_high = p.kAccHighLeg;
h = min(max(height, h_low), p.kCmdHeightMax);
ratio = min(max((h - h_low) / (p.kCmdHeightMax - h_low), 0), 1);
a = a_low - ratio * (a_low - a_high);
end

function traj = local_update_traj(traj, requested_vel, max_vel, height, p, dt)
% chassis.cpp:1101 updateLongitudinalTrajectory
traj.requested_vel = requested_vel;
zero_requested = abs(requested_vel) <= p.kCmdMovingVelEps;
if zero_requested
    traj.requested_vel = 0;
end

target_vel = min(max(traj.requested_vel, -max_vel), max_vel);
last_ref = traj.dpos_ref;

eps_v = p.kCmdMovingVelEps;
same_dir = (target_vel > eps_v && traj.dpos_ref > eps_v) || ...
           (target_vel < -eps_v && traj.dpos_ref < -eps_v);
reducing = zero_requested || ...
           (~same_dir && abs(traj.dpos_ref) > p.kLongTrajRefZeroSnap) || ...
           (same_dir && abs(target_vel) < abs(traj.dpos_ref));

if reducing
    traj.effective_acc_limit = local_leglen_acc(height, p, true);
else
    traj.effective_acc_limit = local_dynamic_acc(traj.dpos_ref, max_vel, ...
        local_leglen_acc(height, p, false));
end

traj.dpos_ref = local_lim_diff(target_vel, traj.dpos_ref, traj.effective_acc_limit, dt);
if zero_requested && abs(traj.dpos_ref) <= p.kLongTrajRefZeroSnap
    traj.dpos_ref = 0;
end
traj.dpos_ref = min(max(traj.dpos_ref, -max_vel), max_vel);

traj.acc_cmd = (traj.dpos_ref - last_ref) / dt;

if zero_requested
    if traj.dpos_ref == 0
        traj.phase = "Hold";
    else
        traj.phase = "BrakeToHold";
    end
elseif ~same_dir && abs(last_ref) > p.kLongTrajRefZeroSnap
    traj.phase = "BrakeToReverse";
else
    traj.phase = "Track";
end
end

function [theta_ffd, dtheta_ffd, scale, theta_max, k_l, gate_latched] = ...
    local_leg_swing_ffd(theta_ffd, height, traj, curr_dpos, p, dt, geom, fw, gate_latched)
% chassis.cpp:989 calcLegSwingFfd
theta_max_leg = fw.theta_max(height);
[scale, gate_latched] = local_demand_scale(traj.requested_vel, curr_dpos, p, gate_latched);
theta_max = theta_max_leg * scale;

% 前馈目标角。两种模型：
%   'firmware' = 固件现在的做法，线性 k(l)*a，k 由 chassis.hpp 的简化式给
%   'exact'    = 用 ffd_geom 的精确质心模型直接求"要 a 就得摆多少度"，
%                含腿质心贡献、h 与 l 的区分、静态质心偏置，不做线性化
if strcmp(p.FfdModel, 'exact')
    th_want = geom.theta_req(height, traj.acc_cmd);
    if p.kFfdSubtractStatic
        % 静态平衡角由 theta_trim_ 负责，前馈只出"因加速而多要的那部分"
        th_want = th_want - geom.theta_static(height);
    end
    % 等效 k 只为记录/判据用
    if abs(traj.acc_cmd) > 1e-6
        k_l = th_want / traj.acc_cmd;
    else
        k_l = geom.k_lin(height);
    end
    th_want = th_want * p.kThetaFfdCalibScaleExact;
else
    k_l = fw.k(height);
    th_want = k_l * traj.acc_cmd;
end

if theta_max <= 1e-4
    theta_ffd = local_lim_diff(0, theta_ffd, p.kPitchMaxDAng, dt);
    dtheta_ffd = 0;
    return;
end

target = min(max(th_want, -theta_max), theta_max);
tau = max(fw.tau(height), dt);
alpha = dt / tau;
err = target - theta_ffd;
theta_ffd = theta_ffd + alpha * err;
theta_ffd = min(max(theta_ffd, -theta_max), theta_max);
dtheta_ffd = err / tau;
end

function u = local_lqr_out(K, Ud, ref, X, p)
% lqrcontrol.cpp:596 calcLQROut，gain 全 1 (Mature/Ctrl)
d = ref - X;
for i = 1:4
    d(i) = min(max(d(i), -p.kLQRMaxError(i)), p.kLQRMaxError(i));
end
u = K * d + Ud;
end

out = struct();
out.name = scen.name;
out.log = L;
out.fell = fell;
out.height = scen.height;
out.k_source = plant.k_source;
out.m = ffd_metrics(L, scen, p, fell);
end

% 腿质心位置与轮轴、髋关节的夹角

phi_w_r = acos((l_w_r^2 + l_r^2 - l_b_r^2)/(2*l_w_r*l_r));

dphi = -R_w/(2*R_l)*(dtheta_w_l - dtheta_w_r) - l_l/(2*R_l)*cos(theta_l_l)*dtheta_l_l + l_r/(2*R_l)*cos(theta_l_r)*dtheta_l_r;

eq2 = m_w * R_w * ddtheta_w_r == f_r - F_ws_r;

eq3 = I_w * ddtheta_w_l == T_wl_l - f_l * R_w;
eq4 = I_w * ddtheta_w_r == T_wl_r - f_r * R_w;

% 2. 腿 (Leg)
% (3) 腿水平平动方程 (基于左右侧拆分)

eq6 = m_l_r * ddS_l_r == F_ws_r - F_bs_r;

% (4) 腿垂直平动方程 (基于左右侧拆分)
eq7 = m_l_l * ddh_l_l == F_wh_l - F_bh_l - m_l_l * g;
eq8 = m_l_r * ddh_l_r == F_wh_r - F_bh_r - m_l_r * g;

eq9 = I_l_l * ddtheta_l_l == F_wh_l*l_w_l*sin(theta_l_l - phi_w_l) - F_ws_l*l_w_l*cos(theta_l_l - phi_w_l) +...

eq10 = I_l_r * ddtheta_l_r == F_wh_r*l_w_r*sin(theta_l_r - phi_w_r) - F_ws_r*l_w_r*cos(theta_l_r - phi_w_r) +...
                              F_bh_r*l_b_r*sin(theta_l_r + phi_b_r) - F_bs_r*l_b_r*cos(theta_l_r + phi_b_r) - T_wl_r + T_bl_r;

% 3. 机体 (Body)
% (6) 机体水平平动方程
eq11 = m_b * ddS_b == F_bs_l + F_bs_r;

% (7) 机体垂直平动方程
eq12 = m_b * ddh_b == F_bh_l + F_bh_r - m_b * g;

% (8)  机体转动方程
eq13 = I_b * ddtheta_b == -(T_bl_l + T_bl_r) - (F_bs_l + F_bs_r)*l_c*cos(theta_b + phi_c) + (F_bh_l + F_bh_r)*l_c*sin(theta_b + phi_c);

% 4. 旋转 (Rotation/Yaw)
% (9) 航向角动力学方程
eq14 = I_zz * ddphi == (-f_l + f_r)*R_l;

% 5. 支持力关系
% (10)
eq15 = F_wh_l == F_wh_r;


elim_vars = [f_l f_r F_ws_l F_ws_r F_wh_l F_wh_r F_bs_l F_bs_r F_bh_l F_bh_r];

elim_eqs = [eq1, eq2, eq3, eq4, eq5, eq6, eq7, eq8, eq12, eq15];

elim_solve = solve(elim_eqs, elim_vars);

eq_sub = subs([eq9, eq10, eq11, eq13, eq14], elim_vars, [elim_solve.f_l, elim_solve.f_r, elim_solve.F_ws_l, elim_solve.F_ws_r, ...
    elim_solve.F_wh_l, elim_solve.F_wh_r, elim_solve.F_bs_l, elim_solve.F_bs_r, elim_solve.F_bh_l, elim_solve.F_bh_r]);

% ==================== 小角度近似与线性化 ====================
% 目标形式：A_orig * ddTheta = B_u * U + B_x * X_sub + B_offset

% 1) 定义向量
ddTheta = [ddtheta_w_l; ddtheta_w_r; ddtheta_l_l; ddtheta_l_r; ddtheta_b];
U = [T_wl_l; T_wl_r; T_bl_l; T_bl_r];
X_sub = [theta_l_l; theta_l_r; theta_b];

% 2) 将方程写成残差形式 F = 0
F = lhs(eq_sub(:)) - rhs(eq_sub(:));

% 3) 以偏置点(零角度、零角速度、零输入、零加速度)做一阶泰勒线性化
aux_vars = [dtheta_w_l; dtheta_w_r; dtheta_l_l; dtheta_l_r; dtheta_b];
Z = [ddTheta; U; X_sub; aux_vars];
Z0 = sym(zeros(size(Z)));

F0 = subs(F, Z, Z0);
J0 = subs(jacobian(F, Z), Z, Z0);
F_lin = simplify(F0 + J0 * (Z - Z0));

% 4) 仅保留题设需要的变量组(忽略角速度项)
F_lin_sub = simplify(subs(F_lin, aux_vars, sym(zeros(size(aux_vars)))));

% 5) 提取矩阵项（先得到左侧形式：A*ddTheta + Bu_l*U + Bx_l*X_sub + c_l = 0）
A_orig = simplify(jacobian(F_lin_sub, ddTheta));
Bu_l = simplify(jacobian(F_lin_sub, U));
Bx_l = simplify(jacobian(F_lin_sub, X_sub));

zero_dd = sym(zeros(size(ddTheta)));
zero_u = sym(zeros(size(U)));
zero_x = sym(zeros(size(X_sub)));
c_l = simplify(subs(F_lin_sub, [ddTheta; U; X_sub], [zero_dd; zero_u; zero_x]));

% 6) 转换为题设形式：A_orig*ddTheta = B_u*U + B_x*X_sub + B_offset
B_u = simplify(-Bu_l);
B_x = simplify(-Bx_l);

%% 左右腿长度二维扫描下的 A_L, B_L 计算

%% 1) 载入静态参数与符号模型
run('param.m');
run('equation.m');

project_dir = fileparts(script_dir);
data_dir = fullfile(project_dir, 'data');
output_dir = fullfile(project_dir, 'output');
if ~exist(data_dir, 'dir')
	mkdir(data_dir);
end
if ~exist(output_dir, 'dir')
	mkdir(output_dir);
end

% 拟合系数文件
fit_mat_file = fullfile(data_dir, 'fit_coeff_poly3.mat');
if ~isfile(fit_mat_file)
	run('param_fit.m');
end

%% 2) 腿长采样范围定义

			m_w, m_l_l, m_l_r, m_b, I_w, I_l_l, I_l_r, I_b, I_zz];

E_sub(1,5) = 1;
E_sub(2,7) = 1;
E_sub(3,9) = 1;

%% 4) 预分配结果容器（二维腿长网格）
% 维度定义：A_L_grid(:,:,i,j) 对应 h_l = h_ls(i), h_r = h_ls(j)
A_L_grid = zeros(10,10,N,N);
B_L_grid = zeros(10,4,N,N);
A_d_grid = zeros(10,10,N,N);
B_d_grid = zeros(10,4,N,N);
U_d_grid = nan(4,N,N);
K_grid = nan(4,10,N,N);
P_grid = nan(10,10,N,N);

%% 5) 左右腿长度二重 for 循环扫描
for i = 1:N
	h_l = h_ls(i);
	for j = 1:N
		h_r = h_ls(j);

		l_w_l_k = polyval(p_lw, h_l);
		l_b_l_k = polyval(p_lb, h_l);
		I_l_l_k = polyval(p_Ileg, h_l);

		l_w_r_k = polyval(p_lw, h_r);
		l_b_r_k = polyval(p_lb, h_r);
		I_l_r_k = polyval(p_Ileg, h_r);

		num_vals = [g_val, R_w_val, R_l_val, h_l, h_r, l_w_l_k, l_w_r_k, l_b_l_k, l_b_r_k, l_c_val, phi_c_val, ...
					m_w_val, m_l_l_val, m_l_r_val, m_b_val, I_w_val, I_l_l_k, I_l_r_k, I_b_val, I_zz_val];

		A_orig_num = double(vpa(subs(A_orig, sym_vars, num_vals)));
		B_u_num = double(vpa(subs(B_u, sym_vars, num_vals)));
		B_x_num = double(vpa(subs(B_x, sym_vars, num_vals)));
		B_offset_num = double(vpa(subs(B_offset, sym_vars, num_vals)));
		T_acc_num = double(vpa(subs(T_acc_eq, sym_vars, num_vals)));

		% 静态平衡前馈 U_d（最小二乘法代入动力学方程）
		% B_u * U_d + B_offset = 0
		% B_u 为 5x4 超定系统，直接最小二乘求解
		% 注：偏航方程自然蕴含 T_wl_l = T_wl_r，无需额外约束
		U_d_k = B_u_num \ (-B_offset_num);
		U_d_grid(:,i,j) = U_d_k;

		Ainv_Bu_num = A_orig_num \ B_u_num;
		Ainv_Bx_num = A_orig_num \ B_x_num;

		A_acc_num = T_acc_num * Ainv_Bx_num * E_sub;
		B_acc_num = T_acc_num * Ainv_Bu_num;

		A_k = zeros(10,10);
		B_k = zeros(10,4);

		A_k(1,2) = 1;
		A_k(3,4) = 1;
		A_k(5,6) = 1;
		A_k(7,8) = 1;
		A_k(9,10) = 1;

		A_k(2,:) = A_acc_num(1,:);
		A_k(4,:) = A_acc_num(2,:);
		A_k(6,:) = A_acc_num(3,:);
		A_k(8,:) = A_acc_num(4,:);
		A_k(10,:) = A_acc_num(5,:);

		B_k(2,:) = B_acc_num(1,:);
		B_k(4,:) = B_acc_num(2,:);
		B_k(6,:) = B_acc_num(3,:);
		B_k(8,:) = B_acc_num(4,:);
		B_k(10,:) = B_acc_num(5,:);

		A_L_grid(:,:,i,j) = A_k;
		B_L_grid(:,:,i,j) = B_k;

		% 连续系统离散化
		sys_c = ss(A_k, B_k, eye(10), zeros(10,4));
		sys_d = c2d(sys_c, Ts_val);
		A_d_k = sys_d.A;
		B_d_k = sys_d.B;

		A_d_grid(:,:,i,j) = A_d_k;
		B_d_grid(:,:,i,j) = B_d_k;

		% 基于 Q, R 的离散 LQR 增益
		try
			[K_k, P_k] = dlqr(A_d_k, B_d_k, Q, R);
			K_grid(:,:,i,j) = K_k;
			P_grid(:,:,i,j) = P_k;
		catch
			% 某些工况不可解时保留 NaN
            K_grid(:,:,i,j) = nan(4,10);
            P_grid(:,:,i,j) = nan(10,10);
            disp(['LQR 不可解: h_l = ', num2str(h_l), ' m, h_r = ', num2str(h_r), ' m']);
		end
	end
end

%% 6) 对K, A, B矩阵进行多项式拟合（poly33）

%% 数值线性化版 LQR 状态空间构造
% 目标：避免符号解析解，直接代入参数进行数值求解
% 输出：A_L_num, B_L_num, U_d_num, A_orig_num, B_u_num, B_x_num, B_offset_num

%% 1) 载入参数
run('param.m');

% 运行符号推导脚本，得到 A_orig, B_u, B_x, B_offset
run('equation.m');

p = struct();
p.g = g_val;
p.R_w = R_w_val;
p.R_l = R_l_val;
p.l_l = l_l_val;
p.l_r = l_r_val;
p.l_w_l = l_w_l_val;
p.l_w_r = l_w_r_val;
p.l_b_l = l_b_l_val;
p.l_b_r = l_b_r_val;
p.l_c = l_c_val;
p.phi_c = phi_c_val;
p.m_w = m_w_val;
p.m_l_l = m_l_l_val;
p.m_l_r = m_l_r_val;
p.m_b = m_b_val;
p.I_w = I_w_val;
p.I_l_l = I_l_l_val;
p.I_l_r = I_l_r_val;
p.I_b = I_b_val;
p.I_zz = I_zz_val;

% 几何夹角（常值）
p.phi_w_l = acos((p.l_w_l^2 + p.l_l^2 - p.l_b_l^2) / (2 * p.l_w_l * p.l_l));
p.phi_w_r = acos((p.l_w_r^2 + p.l_r^2 - p.l_b_r^2) / (2 * p.l_w_r * p.l_r));
p.phi_b_l = acos((p.l_b_l^2 + p.l_l^2 - p.l_w_l^2) / (2 * p.l_b_l * p.l_l));
p.phi_b_r = acos((p.l_b_r^2 + p.l_r^2 - p.l_w_r^2) / (2 * p.l_b_r * p.l_r));

%% 2) 线性化点
% 状态子向量 X_sub = [theta_l_l; theta_l_r; theta_b]
X0 = zeros(3,1);
U0 = zeros(4,1);
DD0 = zeros(5,1);   % ddTheta = [ddtheta_w_l; ddtheta_w_r; ddtheta_l_l; ddtheta_l_r; ddtheta_b]

%% 3) 直接由 equation.m 的解析矩阵代入参数，得到数值矩阵
sym_vars = [g, R_w, R_l, l_l, l_r, l_w_l, l_w_r, l_b_l, l_b_r, l_c, phi_c, ...
            m_w, m_l_l, m_l_r, m_b, I_w, I_l_l, I_l_r, I_b, I_zz];
num_vals = [g_val, R_w_val, R_l_val, l_l_val, l_r_val, l_w_l_val, l_w_r_val, l_b_l_val, l_b_r_val, l_c_val, phi_c_val, ...
            m_w_val, m_l_l_val, m_l_r_val, m_b_val, I_w_val, I_l_l_val, I_l_r_val, I_b_val, I_zz_val];

A_orig_num = double(vpa(subs(A_orig, sym_vars, num_vals)));
B_u_num = double(vpa(subs(B_u, sym_vars, num_vals)));
B_x_num = double(vpa(subs(B_x, sym_vars, num_vals)));
B_offset_num = double(vpa(subs(B_offset, sym_vars, num_vals)));

%% 4) 静态平衡前馈 U_d（最小二乘法代入动力学方程）
% B_u * U_d + B_offset = 0
% B_u 为 5x4 超定系统，直接最小二乘求解
% 注：偏航方程自然蕴含 T_wl_l = T_wl_r，无需额外约束
U_d_num = B_u_num \ (-B_offset_num);

%% 5) 数值方式得到 T_acc（由加速度映射对 ddTheta 求雅各比）
ddX_acc_expr = [dd_s; ddphi; ddtheta_l_l; ddtheta_l_r; ddtheta_b];
T_acc_sym = jacobian(ddX_acc_expr, ddTheta);
T_acc_eq = subs(T_acc_sym, [theta_l_l, theta_l_r, dtheta_l_l, dtheta_l_r], [0, 0, 0, 0]);
T_acc_num = double(vpa(subs(T_acc_eq, sym_vars, num_vals)));

%% 6) 组装十阶状态空间 A_L, B_L
% ddTheta = A_orig^{-1}(B_u*u + B_x*X_sub)
Ainv_Bu_num = A_orig_num \ B_u_num;
Ainv_Bx_num = A_orig_num \ B_x_num;

% X_sub = E_sub * X
E_sub = zeros(3,10);
E_sub(1,5) = 1;
E_sub(2,7) = 1;
E_sub(3,9) = 1;

A_acc_num = T_acc_num * Ainv_Bx_num * E_sub;   % 5x10
B_acc_num = T_acc_num * Ainv_Bu_num;           % 5x4

A_L_num = zeros(10,10);
B_L_num = zeros(10,4);

% 一阶积分关系
A_L_num(1,2) = 1;
A_L_num(3,4) = 1;
A_L_num(5,6) = 1;
A_L_num(7,8) = 1;
A_L_num(9,10) = 1;

% 偶数行填加速度方程
A_L_num(2,:)  = A_acc_num(1,:);
A_L_num(4,:)  = A_acc_num(2,:);
A_L_num(6,:)  = A_acc_num(3,:);
A_L_num(8,:)  = A_acc_num(4,:);
A_L_num(10,:) = A_acc_num(5,:);

# 腿摆角（摆腿）加减速前馈仿真

逐 tick 复刻固件 `Mature/Ctrl` 分支的摆腿前馈整条链路，用于在**上车之前**找
加减速相关参数：

```
updateLongitudinalTrajectory -> acc_cmd -> calcLegSwingFfd
-> theta 参考钳位 -> pos hold / pos_authority_ -> applyLegSwingRefLimit -> calcLQROut
```

被控对象（A/B 矩阵）与 LQR 增益表取自本工程 `../data/AB_scan_leglength.mat`
（由 `../function/lqr_fit.m` 用 `../function/param.m` 的整车参数生成），
与板子上查表用的 `../output/wholebody.hpp` 同一套数据，所以扫出来的参数可直接
搬到固件。

## 跑法

```matlab
cd Matlab\ffd

% 一次性跑完全部基线 + 扫描（约 2 分钟，出全套 csv 与图）
run('sim_leg_swing_ffd.m')

% 日常手动调参（分节脚本，编辑器里 Ctrl+Enter 逐节跑）
edit ffd_tune.m
```

`ffd_tune.m` 各节：0 初始化 / 1 基线 / 2 候选参数（改 `CAND`）对比 /
3 单参数扫描 / 4 联合扫描 / 5 腿长扫描 / 6 单工况逐 tick 细看 /
7 增益来源复核 / 8 精确几何标尺 / 9 打印固件写法。

- 手调唯一入口是 `ffd_tune.m` 第 2 节的 `CAND`。
- 结果图与 csv 写到 `../output/`，全部结果存到 `../data/ffd_sim_results.mat`。
- 改默认参数改 `ffd_params.m`，改工况改 `ffd_scenarios.m`。

## 文件清单

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `sim_leg_swing_ffd.m` | 批处理：基线 + 10 组单参数扫描 + 联合扫描 + 腿长扫描 |
| `ffd_tune.m` | 分节调参台（手动调参从这里开始） |
| `ffd_params.m` | 参数集，镜像固件 `chassis_params.hpp` / `chassis_ctrl_params.hpp` |
| `ffd_plant.m` | 被控对象 + 增益表加载，`KSource` 开关 |
| `ffd_sim.m` | 单次闭环仿真，固件 tick 逐行复刻 |
| `ffd_run.m` | 一行跑一组参数：`outs = ffd_run(struct('kThetaFfdTau',0.05))` |
| `ffd_apply.m` | 参数覆盖（字段名拼错会报错而不是静默无效） |
| `ffd_fw.m` | 固件口径小公式整合：`k(l)` / `tau` / `theta_max` / `cog_height` / `theta_geom` |
| `ffd_scenarios.m` | 标准工况（短按 W / 长按 W / 刹停 / 反打 / 巡航 / 倒车刹停） |
| `ffd_metrics.m` | 指标折算（过零 / 滑行距离 / 摆角峰值 / 实际加减速 …） |
| `ffd_report.m` | 验收表 + OK / WARN / BAD 判定，支持与基线对比 |
| `ffd_sweep.m` / `ffd_sweep2d.m` | 单参数 / 双参数联合扫描 |
| `ffd_plot.m` / `ffd_plot2.m` | 批处理作图 / 两组参数对比作图 |
| `ffd_emit.m` | 把调好的参数打印成固件写法（只打印与基线的差异） |
| `ffd_geom.m` | 精确整车质心模型：`theta_req(h,a)` 精确静力平衡解（标尺） |
| `ffd_geom_lut.m` | `theta_req` 的预计算查表（带 persistent 缓存） |
| `ffd_read_wholebody.m` | 解析 `wholebody.hpp` 的 poly33 系数 |

字段名带 `_deg` 后缀时按度给（如 `kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg_deg`），内部自动转弧度。

## 指标怎么读

`ffd_report` 的表列：`th_pk ffd_pk zc settle dist vrmse tb_pk sat trk`，与基线
对比时多 `d_dist d_th` 两列：

| 列 | 含义 | 想要 |
|---|---|---|
| `zc` | 刹停摆角到达极值**之后**的过零次数 | 0（极值前那次换向是指令要求的，不计入） |
| `dist` | 松手到停稳的滑行距离 (m) | 越小越好，但与 `th_pk` 是死对头 |
| `th_pk` | 峰值实测摆角 (°)，含前馈与 LQR 自己摆的 | < 30° 降权门限，留翻倒余量 |
| `ffd_pk` | 峰值前馈摆角 (°) | 接近 `kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg` 说明上限吃满了 |
| `settle` | 刹停到 \|dpos\|<0.05 且 \|theta\|<1° 的时间 (s) | 越小越好 |
| `tb_pk` | 峰值机体俯仰 (°) | < 2°，大了磕地 |
| `trk` | `leg_swing_track_scale_` 是否被触发 | 0 |
| `vrmse` | 速度跟踪误差 RMS（不含刹停段，那段位置权限已放开） | 越小越好 |

指标结构体 `o.m` 里还有两组表外指标：`acc_achieved` / `dec_achieved`
（**实测**做出来的加/减速度）与 `theta_b_rms`（加减速全程机体俯仰 RMS）。
`acc_achieved` 取的是该段 `dpos-t` 的**最小二乘斜率**（等价于 Δv/Δt），
不是瞬时斜率峰值或中位数——起摆瞬间车速先冲一下再回落，峰值/中位数会把超调
算成"做到了很高加速度"。段长不足 0.4 s 判 NaN（短按 W 只有 0.3 s 斜坡，
量不出加速度，加速侧必须看 `holdW`）。

## 两个关键概念

### 指令高度 h 与真实腿长 l

固件里这两个量都叫 "height"，混用会引入 15% 量级的误差：

- `cmd_.height_f` = **垂直**髋高 `h`，是你下的指令
- 真实的沿腿长度 `l = h / cos(theta)`，`theta` 是摆角

固件按 `leg_ref_state_.height = (cmd_.height_f + ...) / cos(theta)` 下发，
正是这个 `/cos` 让髋关节的垂直高度在摆腿时保持 `R_w + h` 不变——**摆腿时车身
不下坐、保持平**靠的就是它。于是：

| 用途 | 该用哪个 | 固件位置 |
|---|---|---|
| LQR 增益查表 | `l`（`leg_curr_state_.height`） | `lqrcontrol.cpp:94` |
| 前馈的 `k(l)` 与 `theta_max` | `h`（`cmd_.height_f`） | `CalcThetaPerAcc` / `CalcThetaFfdMax` |

前馈只用 `h`，这样前馈只依赖指令，不会形成 `theta → l → k(l) → theta` 的闭环。

### 摆角上限的形状（`kThetaFfdMaxMode`）

| 值 | 含义 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `cutoff` | 旧固件：`kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg` 在 `kFlightHeight=0.23` 处线性衰减到 0 | 只用于复现基线，别拿它调参 |
| `flat` | 上限与腿长无关，只被几何上限压 | 逐腿长搜索用：变量值 == 生效上限 |
| `lerp` | 两端插值 `LowLeg -> HighLeg` + 几何上限 | 写进板子的形状 |

旧固件 `cutoff` 的问题：产生同一加速度所需的摆角随腿长只是**缓降**，而上限
**陡降到 0**，长腿时前馈发不出来，减速只能靠 LQR 事后补，实测摆角峰值反而
更大。几何上限才是真正的硬上限：摆腿时 `l = h/cos(theta) <= kCmdHeightMax`，
即 `theta <= acos(h/kCmdHeightMax)`，在 h≈0.30 以上才开始起作用。

## KSource 开关

`ffd_plant('KSource', src)` 决定 K/U_d 的来源：

| KSource | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `hpp_raw` | 读 `../output/wholebody.hpp` 的 poly33 系数，按**原始腿长**求值 = 板子上的增益 |
| `hpp_norm` | 同系数按 `(h-mu)/sd` 求值（`fit(...,'Normalize','on')` 口径） |
| `truth` | `AB_scan_leglength.mat` 里 `dlqr` 的原始网格 = 设计意图 |

**注意**：本工程的 `lqr_fit.m` 用 `'Normalize','off'` 拟合，因此 `hpp_raw` 与
`truth` 基本一致（只差 poly33 拟合残差 ~1e-3），`hpp_norm` 反而是错的求值方式。
两种来源都跑一遍只是交叉验证，不像源工程那样必须分清给哪一版调参。

## 本工程适配说明

1. **机械参数已同步**：`ffd_params.m` 的 `kGravAcc=9.8`、`m_b=20`、`m_w=0.3`、
   `m_l=2.0` 与本工程 `../function/param.m` 一致，与被控对象数据自洽。
2. **标定表是起点不是终点**：`kThetaFfdCalibScale` 表 / `kThetaFfdTau` 表 /
   加减速上限等是源工程（不同质量分布）调出来的结果。首次使用请用
   `ffd_tune.m` 第 2 节 `CAND` 重扫：源值在改质量后已偏（基线工况 tapW 机体
   俯仰 4.0° 超标，`kMaxCmdMovingAcc` 扫到 2.6 就触发了降权门限）。
3. **扫 tau / calib 会清空值表**：`ffd_sweep` / `ffd_sweep2d` 在扫
   `kThetaFfdTau` / `kThetaFfdCalibScale` 标量时与 `ffd_apply` 同规则清空对应
   值表，否则默认参数下的扫描会静默无效果（值表按腿长插值把标量覆盖吃掉了）。
4. `ffd_geom` 读 `../data/static_params.mat`（由 `../function/param.m` 写入），
   精确几何标尺自动用本工程参数。

## 与固件的已知差异（本仿真能回答什么）

仿真只含 10 阶整机模型，**不含**以下环节，所以它能回答"参考规划得对不对、
摆角会到多大、刹停会不会振荡"，但不能回答"腿长环会不会打架、五连杆会不会
到限位"：

- 腿长环与五连杆正逆解：腿长按 `cmd_.height_f` 的斜坡取值
- 防劈叉 `dtq_`（左右腿对称工况下本来就为 0）
- KF / EKF：直接用真实状态，无观测噪声与滞后
- 重力前馈、离心补偿、弹簧补偿
- 支撑力估计与 LTR、`phi` 误差钳位（纵向工况里 `phi` 恒为 0）

## 与源工程的取舍（为什么只有这些文件）

本目录是 `BalanceRobot2026/simulation/26/LQR` 中腿摆角前馈部分的**精简整合版**，
去掉的内容及其理由：

- **自动寻参优化器**（`ffd_spec` / `ffd_cost` / `ffd_vars` / `ffd_opt` /
  `ffd_opt_sweep*` / `ffd_emit_sched`）：约 1 秒一次代价求值、跑一轮要几分钟，
  且搜索结果已固化在参数表里；手调用 `CAND` + 扫描即可达到同样效果。
- **一次性验证脚本**（`ffd_verify`）与旧固件回归基线之外的零散脚本。
- 五个小公式文件（`ffd_cog_height` / `ffd_k_ffd` / `ffd_tau_at` /
  `ffd_theta_max` / `ffd_theta_geom`）**整合为 `ffd_fw.m`**，仿真只用一处实现，
  不会再出现"改了一个文件、另一个忘了改"的漂移；`ffd_sim` 里重复的
  `local_cog_height` 一并删除。
- `ffd_tune.m` 删去了依赖优化器的第 9/10 节，保留手调-扫描-几何标尺全流程。

function fw = ffd_fw(p)
%FFD_FW 固件口径小公式整合：k(l) / tau / theta_max / cog_height / theta_geom
%
%   fw = ffd_fw(p)
%
%   返回函数句柄，字段与固件 chassis.hpp 静态函数一一对应：
%     fw.cog_h(l)      整车质心高度 H(l)              CalcSystemCogHeight
%     fw.k_raw(l)      单位加速度所需摆角的纯公式值   H*M/(g*m_swing*l)
%     fw.k(l)          含标定系数的 k(l)              CalcThetaPerAcc
%     fw.tau(l)        前馈一阶滤波时间常数(随腿长插值) LerpByHeight
%     fw.theta_max(l)  前馈摆角上限                    CalcThetaFfdMax
%     fw.theta_geom(l) 几何硬上限 acos(h/kCmdHeightMax) CalcThetaGeomMax
%
%   原实现分散在 ffd_cog_height.m / ffd_k_ffd.m / ffd_tau_at.m /
%   ffd_theta_max.m / ffd_theta_geom.m 五个文件里，内容相同，此处整合为一个
%   文件：仿真只用这一处实现，不会出现"改了一个文件、另一个忘了改"的漂移。
%   字段带 _deg 的说明见 ffd_params.m，_deg 后缀在 ffd_apply / ffd_sweep 里自动换算。

leg_mass = p.kWheelMass + p.kLegMass;
total    = p.kBodyMass + 2 * leg_mass;

mode = 'body';
if isfield(p, 'kThetaFfdSwingMassMode') && ~isempty(p.kThetaFfdSwingMassMode)
    mode = p.kThetaFfdSwingMassMode;
end
switch mode
    case 'body', m_swing = p.kBodyMass;
    case 'legs', m_swing = p.kBodyMass + leg_mass;
    otherwise
        error('ffd_fw:massMode', 'kThetaFfdSwingMassMode 只能是 body/legs，收到 "%s"', mode);
end

fw = struct();
fw.cog_h = @(l) local_cog_height(l, p);
fw.k_raw = @(l) local_k_raw(l, p, m_swing, total);
fw.k     = @(l) local_k_raw(l, p, m_swing, total) .* local_calib(l, p);
fw.tau   = @(l) local_tau(l, p);
fw.theta_geom = @(l) local_theta_geom(l, p);
fw.theta_max  = @(l) local_theta_max(l, p);
end

% ================================================================ 实现

function H = local_cog_height(leg_len, p)
% chassis.hpp CalcSystemCogHeight
leg_mass = p.kWheelMass + p.kLegMass;
total = p.kBodyMass + 2 * leg_mass;
wheel_r = p.kWheelDiam * 0.5;
H = (p.kBodyMass * (p.kBodyCogHeightAboveHip + leg_len + wheel_r) + ...
     2 * leg_mass * (leg_len + wheel_r) * 0.5) / total;
end

function k = local_k_raw(leg_len, p, m_swing, total)
% chassis.hpp CalcThetaPerAcc 的不含标定系数部分 H(l)*M/(g*m_swing*l)
% m_swing 由 kThetaFfdSwingMassMode 决定：
%   'body'  旧固件，分母只有机体质量 m_b。忽略了腿质心同样随摆角前移，k 偏大
%           11% 左右且随腿长漂移，要靠常数标定系数吸收。
%   'legs'  分母 m_b + (m_w+m_l)，与 ffd_geom 的精确解在 h=0.12~0.32 差 <1.2%，
%           标定系数因此是接近 1 的真无量纲量。
l = max(leg_len, p.kCmdHeightMin);
k = local_cog_height(l, p) .* total ./ (p.kGravAcc * m_swing .* l);
end

function calib = local_calib(l, p)
% 标定系数：值表存在就按腿长插值(与固件 LerpByHeight 一致)，否则用标量。
% ffd_apply 在覆盖 kThetaFfdCalibScale 标量时会清空值表，让标量生效。
calib = p.kThetaFfdCalibScale;
if isfield(p, 'kThetaFfdCalibValLut') && ~isempty(p.kThetaFfdCalibValLut)
    calib = local_lerp(l, p.kThetaFfdCalibHeightLut, p.kThetaFfdCalibValLut);
end
end

function tau = local_tau(h, p)
% 前馈一阶滤波时间常数。与固件一致：存在值表就按腿长插值，否则用标量。
if isfield(p, 'kThetaFfdTauValLut') && ~isempty(p.kThetaFfdTauValLut)
    tau = local_lerp(h, p.kThetaFfdTauHeightLut, p.kThetaFfdTauValLut);
else
    tau = p.kThetaFfdTau;
end
end

function v = local_lerp(h, hl, vl)
% 与固件 LerpByHeight 一致：线性插值，两端取端点值不外推
if h <= hl(1), v = vl(1); return; end
if h >= hl(end), v = vl(end); return; end
v = interp1(hl, vl, h, 'linear');
end

function th = local_theta_geom(h, p)
% chassis.hpp CalcThetaGeomMax
% 摆腿时固件按 l = h / cos(theta) 下发腿长以保持髋高不变(chassis.cpp:2290)，
% 故沿腿长度 l 不得超过五连杆行程 kCmdHeightMax：
%     h / cos(theta) <= kCmdHeightMax   ->   theta <= acos(h / kCmdHeightMax)
% 这条限制随腿长收紧(h=0.12 时 69.9°、h=0.30 时 31°、h=0.35 时 0°)，
% 与 ffd_geom().th_geom_max 同式(那边是精确几何模型里的同一件事，用于校核)。
th = acos(min(max(h / p.kCmdHeightMax, 0), 1));
end

function tm = local_theta_max(leg_len, p)
% chassis.hpp CalcThetaFfdMax，三种形状由 p.kThetaFfdMaxMode 选：
%
%   'cutoff'  旧固件：kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg 在 kThetaFfdCutoffHeight(=kFlightHeight
%             =0.23) 处线性衰减到 0。只用于复现基线，别拿它调参。
%   'flat'    上限与腿长无关，就是 kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg，只被几何上限压。
%   'lerp'    两端线性插值 kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg -> kThetaFfdMaxHighLeg，再被几何
%             上限压。这是要写进板子的形状。
%
%   为什么弃用 'cutoff'：产生同一加速度所需摆角随腿长只是缓降(ffd_geom:
%   2.5 m/s^2 需要 25.1°@h=0.12 -> 19.1°@h=0.32)，而 'cutoff' 让上限陡降到 0
%   (12°@0.12 -> 0°@0.23)。斜率不匹配导致长腿前馈被砍到几乎为零，减速全靠 LQR
%   事后补，实测摆角峰值反而更大。

mode = 'cutoff';
if isfield(p, 'kThetaFfdMaxMode') && ~isempty(p.kThetaFfdMaxMode)
    mode = p.kThetaFfdMaxMode;
end

switch mode
    case 'cutoff'
        tm = local_cutoff(leg_len, p);
        return;   % 旧形状不叠几何上限，保持与旧固件逐位一致
    case 'flat'
        tm = p.kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg;
    case 'lerp'
        span = p.kCmdHeightMax - p.kCmdHeightMin;
        if span <= 1e-6
            tm = p.kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg;
        else
            h = min(max(leg_len, p.kCmdHeightMin), p.kCmdHeightMax);
            r = (h - p.kCmdHeightMin) / span;
            tm = p.kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg + r * (p.kThetaFfdMaxHighLeg - p.kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg);
        end
    otherwise
        error('ffd_fw:maxMode', 'kThetaFfdMaxMode 只能是 cutoff/flat/lerp，收到 "%s"', mode);
end

tm = min(tm, p.kThetaFfdGeomMargin * local_theta_geom(leg_len, p));
tm = max(tm, 0);
end

function tm = local_cutoff(leg_len, p)
if leg_len >= p.kThetaFfdCutoffHeight
    tm = 0;
    return;
end
span = p.kThetaFfdCutoffHeight - p.kCmdHeightMin;
if span <= 1e-6
    tm = 0;
    return;
end
ratio = min(max((leg_len - p.kCmdHeightMin) / span, 0), 1);
tm = p.kThetaFfdMaxLowLeg * (1 - ratio);
end

function plant = ffd_plant(varargin)
%FFD_PLANT 载入腿摆角前馈仿真所需的连续被控对象与 LQR 增益表
%
%   plant = ffd_plant('KSource', src, 'HppFile', f)
%
%   'KSource' 决定 K/U_d 的来源，这是本仿真最关键的开关：
%     'truth'      直接用 data/AB_scan_leglength.mat 里 dlqr 的原始网格插值。
%                  = 设计意图，也是重新建表后板子上会跑的东西。
%     'hpp_norm'   读 output/wholebody.hpp 的 poly33 系数，按 (h-mu)/sd 归一化
%                  后求值。= lqr_fit.m 用 'Normalize','on' 拟合时的正确求值方式。
%     'hpp_raw'    读同样的系数，直接代入原始腿长求值。
%                  = 固件 multiPoly33Val 现在真正做的事。
%
%   注意：本工程的 lqr_fit.m 用 'Normalize','off' 拟合，故 'hpp_raw' 与
%   'truth' 基本一致(相差只是 poly33 拟合残差 ~1e-3 量级)；'hpp_norm' 反而是
%   错的求值方式(归一化系数没写进固件)，这里保留三种口径只是方便对照。
%
%   A_L/B_L 始终取自 data/AB_scan_leglength.mat 的网格(被控对象与增益表来源无关)。
%
%   返回字段:
%     plant.getAB(h_l, h_r) -> [A(10x10), B(10x4)]  连续时间
%     plant.getK(h_l, h_r)  -> K(4x10)              固件符号约定: u = K*(ref-curr)
%     plant.getUd(h_l, h_r) -> U_d(4x1)
%     plant.h_ls, plant.mu, plant.sd, plant.k_source

ip = inputParser;
ip.addParameter('KSource', 'hpp_raw', @(s) ismember(s, {'truth','hpp_norm','hpp_raw'}));
ip.addParameter('HppFile', '', @ischar);
ip.parse(varargin{:});
opt = ip.Results;

here = fileparts(mfilename('fullpath'));
proj = fileparts(here);
mat_file = fullfile(proj, 'data', 'AB_scan_leglength.mat');
if ~isfile(mat_file)
    error('ffd_plant:missingScan', ...
        '缺少 %s，先运行 lqr_fit.m 生成腿长扫描结果。', mat_file);
end
S = load(mat_file, 'h_ls', 'A_L_grid', 'B_L_grid', 'U_d_grid', 'K_grid');

h_ls = S.h_ls(:)';
N = numel(h_ls);

% 归一化常数：与 MATLAB fit(...,'Normalize','on') 的定义一致
% (对 xdata/ydata 各自去均值除标准差，网格对称故两轴相同)
[X, Y] = meshgrid(h_ls, h_ls);
mu = mean(X(:));
sd = std(X(:));

%% 被控对象：对 (h_l, h_r) 双线性插值
A_grid = S.A_L_grid;   % 10x10xNxN
B_grid = S.B_L_grid;   % 10x4 xNxN

getAB = @(hl, hr) local_interp_ab(A_grid, B_grid, h_ls, hl, hr);

%% 增益表
switch opt.KSource
    case 'truth'
        K_grid = S.K_grid;      % 4x10xNxN
        Ud_grid = S.U_d_grid;   % 4xNxN
        getK  = @(hl, hr) local_interp_nd(K_grid, h_ls, hl, hr, [4 10]);
        getUd = @(hl, hr) reshape( ...
            local_interp_nd(reshape(Ud_grid, [4 1 N N]), h_ls, hl, hr, [4 1]), [4 1]);
        coeff_src = mat_file;
    otherwise
        hpp = opt.HppFile;
        if isempty(hpp)
            % 默认读本工程 output/wholebody.hpp(由 function/lqr_fit.m 生成的那份)
            hpp = fullfile(proj, 'output', 'wholebody.hpp');
        end
        C = ffd_read_wholebody(hpp);
        normalize = strcmp(opt.KSource, 'hpp_norm');
        getK  = @(hl, hr) local_poly_K(C.K, hl, hr, normalize, mu, sd);
        getUd = @(hl, hr) local_poly_Ud(C.Ud, hl, hr, normalize, mu, sd);
        coeff_src = hpp;
end

plant = struct();
plant.getAB    = getAB;
plant.getK     = getK;
plant.getUd    = getUd;
plant.h_ls     = h_ls;
plant.mu       = mu;
plant.sd       = sd;
plant.k_source = opt.KSource;
plant.coeff_src = coeff_src;
end

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

function [A, B] = local_interp_ab(A_grid, B_grid, h_ls, hl, hr)
A = local_interp_nd(A_grid, h_ls, hl, hr, [10 10]);
B = local_interp_nd(B_grid, h_ls, hl, hr, [10 4]);
end

function M = local_interp_nd(G, h_ls, hl, hr, sz)
% G: sz(1) x sz(2) x N x N，对后两维做双线性插值(超出范围时钳到边界)
N = numel(h_ls);
[i0, i1, wi] = local_idx(h_ls, hl, N);
[j0, j1, wj] = local_idx(h_ls, hr, N);
M = (1-wi)*(1-wj) * G(:,:,i0,j0) + wi*(1-wj) * G(:,:,i1,j0) + ...
    (1-wi)*   wj  * G(:,:,i0,j1) + wi*   wj  * G(:,:,i1,j1);
M = reshape(M, sz);
end

function [i0, i1, w] = local_idx(h_ls, h, N)
h = min(max(h, h_ls(1)), h_ls(end));
t = (h - h_ls(1)) / (h_ls(2) - h_ls(1));
i0 = min(max(floor(t) + 1, 1), N);
i1 = min(i0 + 1, N);
w = t - (i0 - 1);
end

function K = local_poly_K(Kc, hl, hr, normalize, mu, sd)
% Kc: 4x10x10 (行, 列, poly33 系数)
[x, y] = local_scale(hl, hr, normalize, mu, sd);
K = zeros(4, 10);
for i = 1:4
    for j = 1:10
        K(i,j) = local_poly33(squeeze(Kc(i,j,:)), x, y);
    end
end
end

function Ud = local_poly_Ud(Uc, hl, hr, normalize, mu, sd)
[x, y] = local_scale(hl, hr, normalize, mu, sd);
Ud = zeros(4, 1);
for i = 1:4
    Ud(i) = local_poly33(Uc(i,:), x, y);
end
end

function [x, y] = local_scale(hl, hr, normalize, mu, sd)
if normalize
    x = (hl - mu) / sd;
    y = (hr - mu) / sd;
else
    x = hl;
    y = hr;
end
end

function v = local_poly33(p, x, y)
% 与 lqrcontrol.cpp:64 multiPoly33Val 的系数顺序严格一致
% p = [p00 p10 p01 p20 p11 p02 p30 p21 p12 p03]
v = p(1) + p(2)*x + p(3)*y + p(4)*x*x + p(5)*x*y + p(6)*y*y + ...
    p(7)*x*x*x + p(8)*x*x*y + p(9)*x*y*y + p(10)*y*y*y;
end

function out = ffd_sim(scen, p, plant, varargin)
%FFD_SIM 腿摆角前馈 + LQR 闭环仿真，逐 tick 复刻固件 Mature/Ctrl 分支
%
%   out = ffd_sim(scen, p, plant)
%
%   scen : ffd_scenarios() 里的一条工况，需含
%          .name, .T (s), .height (指令腿长 m), .v_cmd (函数句柄 t->m/s),
%          .x0 (可选, 10x1 初始状态)
%   p    : ffd_params() 返回的参数结构
%   plant: ffd_plant() 返回的被控对象/增益表
%
%   可选项:
%     'LegLenFrozen' (true)  被控对象/增益按 cmd_.height_f 取值。固件用的是实测
%                            腿长，但腿长环由独立 PID 跟踪 height_f 且本仿真不含
%                            五连杆，故用 height_f 近似。
%     'Trim' (false)         是否启用 theta_trim_ 慢积分(10s 量级，短工况里基本不动)
%
%   固件对应关系(chassis.cpp)：
%     updateLongitudinalTrajectory  -> local_update_traj
%     calcLegSwingFfd               -> local_leg_swing_ffd
%     pos hold / pos_authority_     -> 主循环内
%     applyLegSwingRefLimit         -> local_apply_ref_limit
%     calcLQROut                    -> local_lqr_out
%
%   状态与固件一致:
%     X = [pos dpos phi dphi theta_l dtheta_l theta_r dtheta_r theta_b dtheta_b]'
%     u = [T_w_l T_w_r T_b_l T_b_r]'

ip = inputParser;
ip.addParameter('LegLenFrozen', true, @islogical);
ip.addParameter('Trim', false, @islogical);
ip.addParameter('LegLenMode', 'proj', @(s) ismember(s, {'cmd', 'proj'}));
ip.parse(varargin{:});
opt = ip.Results;

dt = p.kCtrlPeriod;
n  = round(scen.T / dt);

% 精确几何模型。theta_req 里有 fzero，每 tick 求根太慢，故预先在 (h, a) 网格上
% 建插值表。h 用指令高度(工况内按 kMaxDH 斜坡，范围有限)，a 覆盖加减速上限。
geom = [];
if strcmp(p.FfdModel, 'exact')
    geom = ffd_geom_lut(p);
end

% 固件口径小公式(k/tau/theta_max/cog_height)整合在 ffd_fw 里，取一次复用
fw = ffd_fw(p);

%% ---- 状态初始化 (对应 MatureState::Init) ----
X = zeros(10, 1);
if isfield(scen, 'x0') && ~isempty(scen.x0)
    X = scen.x0(:);
end

% 轨迹状态 (LongitudinalTrajectory)
traj = struct('dpos_ref', X(2), 'requested_vel', 0, 'acc_cmd', 0, ...
              'effective_acc_limit', 0, 'phase', "Hold");

theta_ffd  = 0;
dtheta_ffd = 0;
theta_trim = 0;
demand_scale = 0;
gate_latched = false;
pos_authority = 1.0;
track_scale = 1.0;
pos_hold_active = false;
theta_b_ref = 0;

% 参考状态
ref = zeros(10, 1);
ref(1) = X(1);
ref(2) = X(2);

% cmd_.height_f 从初始腿长斜坡到指令腿长
height_f = scen.height;
if isfield(scen, 'height0') && ~isempty(scen.height0)
    height_f = scen.height0;
end

%% ---- 日志 ----
L = struct();
flds = {'t','pos','dpos','theta_l','dtheta_l','theta_b','dtheta_b','theta_fdb', ...
        'dpos_ref','acc_cmd','acc_limit','theta_ffd','dtheta_ffd','theta_ref', ...
        'theta_trim','demand','demand_scale','theta_max','pos_authority', ...
        'track_scale','pos_err','height_f','k_l','Tw','Tb','pos_hold', ...
        'requested_vel','braking'};
for i = 1:numel(flds)
    L.(flds{i}) = zeros(n, 1);
end

%% ---- 主循环 ----
for k = 1:n
    t = (k-1) * dt;

    % cmd_.height_f 斜坡 (chassis.cpp:2234)
    height_f = local_lim_diff(scen.height, height_f, p.kMaxDH, dt);
    height_f = min(max(height_f, p.kCmdHeightMin), p.kCmdHeightMax);

    % ---- 指令高度 h 与真实腿长 l 的区分 ----
    % cmd_.height_f 是髋关节的**垂直**高度 h。固件 chassis.cpp:2290 下发的是
    %     leg_ref_state_.height = cmd_.height_f / cos(theta)
    % 即真实的沿腿长度 l = h/cos(theta)，这么做正是为了摆腿时车身高度不变(车身平)。
    %
    % 而 LQR 增益表是按 leg_curr_state_.height 查的(lqrcontrol.cpp:94)，也就是
    % 按 l 查，不是按 h 查。摆到 30° 时 l/h = 1.155，查表位置差 15%，不能忽略。
    %   'proj' = 按 l = h/cos(theta) 查表，与固件一致(默认)
    %   'cmd'  = 按 h 查表，即旧版仿真的做法，留作对照
    theta_meas = (X(5) + X(7)) * 0.5;
    if strcmp(opt.LegLenMode, 'proj')
        leg_len = height_f / max(cos(theta_meas), 0.2);
    else
        leg_len = height_f;
    end
    leg_len = min(max(leg_len, p.kCmdHeightMin), p.kCmdHeightMax);
    h_eff = leg_len;

    K  = plant.getK(h_eff, h_eff);
    Ud = plant.getUd(h_eff, h_eff);
    [Ac, Bc] = plant.getAB(h_eff, h_eff);

    %% theta_b 参考 (chassis.cpp:5519)
    theta_b_ref = local_lim_diff(p.kThetaBodyBias, theta_b_ref, p.kPitchMaxDAng, dt);
    theta_b_ref = min(max(theta_b_ref, -0.2), 0.2);
    ref(9)  = theta_b_ref;
    ref(10) = 0;

    %% 大摆角降权 updateLegSwingTrackScale (chassis.cpp:925)
    raw_scale = 1 - local_smoothstep01( ...
        (max(abs(X(5)), abs(X(7))) - p.kLegSwingTrackStartTheta) / ...
        (p.kLegSwingTrackStopTheta - p.kLegSwingTrackStartTheta));
    rate = p.kLegSwingTrackScaleUpRate;
    if raw_scale < track_scale
        rate = p.kLegSwingTrackScaleDownRate;
    end
    track_scale = local_lim_diff(raw_scale, track_scale, rate, dt);
    if track_scale < p.kLegSwingTrackScaleEps
        track_scale = 0;
    end

    %% 速度指令 (chassis.cpp:5551)
    v_cmd = scen.v_cmd(t);
    speed_limit = p.kMaxMovingSpeed;
    requested_speed = v_cmd * track_scale;
    requested_speed = min(max(requested_speed, -speed_limit), speed_limit);

    %% updateLongitudinalTrajectory
    traj = local_update_traj(traj, requested_speed, speed_limit, height_f, p, dt);
    ref(2) = min(max(traj.dpos_ref, -speed_limit), speed_limit);

    %% calcLegSwingFfd
    % 前馈的腿长参数一律用**指令**高度 height_f，不用实测 l：指令量只与操作
    % 意图相关，不会被摆角自身污染，否则 theta -> l -> k(l) -> theta 成环。
    [theta_ffd, dtheta_ffd, demand_scale, theta_max, k_l, gate_latched] = ...
        local_leg_swing_ffd(theta_ffd, height_f, traj, X(2), p, dt, geom, fw, gate_latched);

    % 总钳位留 theta_trim_ 余量 (chassis.cpp:5623)
    theta_cmd_max = fw.theta_max(height_f) + p.kThetaTrimMax;
    theta_cmd = min(max(theta_ffd + theta_trim, -theta_cmd_max), theta_cmd_max);
    ref(5) = theta_cmd;  ref(6) = dtheta_ffd;
    ref(7) = theta_cmd;  ref(8) = dtheta_ffd;

    %% 位置锁定 / pos_authority_ (chassis.cpp:5634)
    braking = strcmp(traj.phase, "BrakeToHold") || strcmp(traj.phase, "BrakeToReverse");
    zero_input = abs(traj.requested_vel) <= p.kCmdMovingVelEps;
    avg_theta = (X(5) + X(7)) * 0.5;
    enter_pos_hold = zero_input && abs(X(2)) < p.kLongTrajPosHoldEnterSpeed && ...
                     abs(avg_theta) < p.kPosHoldEnterTheta;
    if ~zero_input
        pos_hold_active = false;
    end

    if enter_pos_hold && ~pos_hold_active
        ref(1) = X(1);                 % reanchorLongitudinalPosition
        pos_hold_active = true;
    elseif braking && ~pos_hold_active
        ref(1) = X(1);
    elseif abs(ref(2)) > p.kCmdMovingVelEps
        ref(1) = ref(1) + ref(2) * dt;
    end
    ref(1) = min(max(ref(1), X(1) - p.kAirPosMaxBias), X(1) + p.kAirPosMaxBias);

    release_pos_authority = braking && ~pos_hold_active;
    if release_pos_authority
        pos_authority = local_lim_diff(0, pos_authority, p.kPosAuthorityDownRate, dt);
    else
        pos_authority = local_lim_diff(1, pos_authority, p.kPosAuthorityUpRate, dt);
    end

    %% updateThetaTrim (chassis.cpp:1033)
    if opt.Trim && pos_hold_active
        theta_trim = theta_trim + p.kThetaTrimKi * (ref(1) - X(1)) * dt;
        theta_trim = min(max(theta_trim, -p.kThetaTrimMax), p.kThetaTrimMax);
    end

    %% applyLegSwingRefLimit (chassis.cpp:945)
    pos_err_raw = ref(1) - X(1);
    ref_eff = ref;
    ref_eff(1) = X(1) + track_scale * pos_authority * pos_err_raw;
    ref_eff(3) = X(3) + track_scale * (ref(3) - X(3));
    ref_eff(4) = ref(4) * track_scale;

    %% calcLQROut (lqrcontrol.cpp:596)
    u = local_lqr_out(K, Ud, ref_eff, X, p);

    % 执行器饱和：轮毂 ±kWheelMaxTq，关节 ±kJointMaxTq
    u(1:2) = min(max(u(1:2), -p.kWheelMaxTq), p.kWheelMaxTq);
    u(3:4) = min(max(u(3:4), -p.kJointMaxTq), p.kJointMaxTq);

    %% 记录
    L.t(k) = t;
    L.pos(k) = X(1);          L.dpos(k) = X(2);
    L.theta_l(k) = X(5);      L.dtheta_l(k) = X(6);
    L.theta_b(k) = X(9);      L.dtheta_b(k) = X(10);
    L.theta_fdb(k) = avg_theta;
    L.dpos_ref(k) = ref(2);   L.acc_cmd(k) = traj.acc_cmd;
    L.acc_limit(k) = traj.effective_acc_limit;
    L.theta_ffd(k) = theta_ffd;  L.dtheta_ffd(k) = dtheta_ffd;
    L.theta_ref(k) = theta_cmd;  L.theta_trim(k) = theta_trim;
    L.demand(k) = abs(traj.requested_vel - X(2));
    L.demand_scale(k) = demand_scale;
    L.theta_max(k) = theta_max;
    L.pos_authority(k) = pos_authority;
    L.track_scale(k) = track_scale;
    L.pos_err(k) = pos_err_raw;
    L.height_f(k) = height_f;
    L.k_l(k) = k_l;
    L.Tw(k) = u(1);  L.Tb(k) = u(3);
    L.pos_hold(k) = double(pos_hold_active);
    L.requested_vel(k) = traj.requested_vel;
    L.braking(k) = double(braking);

    %% 积分：连续模型 + 零阶保持，一步 RK4
    f = @(x) Ac * x + Bc * u;
    k1 = f(X);
    k2 = f(X + 0.5*dt*k1);
    k3 = f(X + 0.5*dt*k2);
    k4 = f(X + dt*k3);
    X = X + (dt/6) * (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4);

    if any(~isfinite(X)) || abs(X(9)) > pi/2
        % 机体倒下，截断日志
        for i = 1:numel(flds)
            L.(flds{i}) = L.(flds{i})(1:k);
        end
        out = local_pack(L, scen, p, plant, true);
        return;
    end
end

out = local_pack(L, scen, p, plant, false);
end

% ================================================================ 固件函数

function y = local_lim_diff(ref_v, curr_v, max_diff, dt)
% tool.hpp:201 LimDiff
d = ref_v - curr_v;
m = max_diff * dt;
d = min(max(d, -m), m);
y = curr_v + d;
end

function y = local_smoothstep01(x)
% chassis.hpp:867
x = min(max(x, 0), 1);
y = x * x * (3 - 2 * x);
end

function [s, latched] = local_demand_scale(requested_vel, curr_vel, p, latched)
% chassis.hpp CalcThetaFfdDemandScale，带施密特滞回
demand = abs(requested_vel - curr_vel);
if ~latched
    if demand < p.kThetaFfdDemandEnter
        s = 0;
        return;
    end
    latched = true;
elseif demand <= p.kThetaFfdDemandDeadband
    latched = false;
end
full = p.kMaxMovingSpeed * p.kThetaFfdDemandFullRatio;
span = full - p.kThetaFfdDemandDeadband;
if span <= 1e-6
    s = 1;
    return;
end
s = min(max((demand - p.kThetaFfdDemandDeadband) / span, 0), 1);
end

function a = local_dynamic_acc(curr_vel, max_vel, max_acc)
% chassis.hpp CalcDynamicCmdMovingAcc
ratio_min = 0.8;
bounded = max(max_vel, 1e-6);
vr = min(max(abs(curr_vel) / bounded, 0), 1);
a_min = max_acc * ratio_min;
a = a_min + (max_acc - a_min) * cos(pi * 0.5 * vr);
a = min(max(a, a_min), max_acc);
end

function a = local_leglen_acc(height, p, decel)
% chassis.hpp CalcLegLengthScaledMaxCmdMovingAcc / ...DecAcc
h_low = p.kFlightHeight - 0.03;
if decel
    a_low = p.kMaxCmdMovingDecAcc;
else
    a_low = p.kMaxCmdMovingAcc;
end
a_high = p.kAccHighLeg;
h = min(max(height, h_low), p.kCmdHeightMax);
ratio = min(max((h - h_low) / (p.kCmdHeightMax - h_low), 0), 1);
a = a_low - ratio * (a_low - a_high);
end

function traj = local_update_traj(traj, requested_vel, max_vel, height, p, dt)
% chassis.cpp:1101 updateLongitudinalTrajectory
traj.requested_vel = requested_vel;
zero_requested = abs(requested_vel) <= p.kCmdMovingVelEps;
if zero_requested
    traj.requested_vel = 0;
end

target_vel = min(max(traj.requested_vel, -max_vel), max_vel);
last_ref = traj.dpos_ref;

eps_v = p.kCmdMovingVelEps;
same_dir = (target_vel > eps_v && traj.dpos_ref > eps_v) || ...
           (target_vel < -eps_v && traj.dpos_ref < -eps_v);
reducing = zero_requested || ...
           (~same_dir && abs(traj.dpos_ref) > p.kLongTrajRefZeroSnap) || ...
           (same_dir && abs(target_vel) < abs(traj.dpos_ref));

if reducing
    traj.effective_acc_limit = local_leglen_acc(height, p, true);
else
    traj.effective_acc_limit = local_dynamic_acc(traj.dpos_ref, max_vel, ...
        local_leglen_acc(height, p, false));
end

traj.dpos_ref = local_lim_diff(target_vel, traj.dpos_ref, traj.effective_acc_limit, dt);
if zero_requested && abs(traj.dpos_ref) <= p.kLongTrajRefZeroSnap
    traj.dpos_ref = 0;
end
traj.dpos_ref = min(max(traj.dpos_ref, -max_vel), max_vel);

traj.acc_cmd = (traj.dpos_ref - last_ref) / dt;

if zero_requested
    if traj.dpos_ref == 0
        traj.phase = "Hold";
    else
        traj.phase = "BrakeToHold";
    end
elseif ~same_dir && abs(last_ref) > p.kLongTrajRefZeroSnap
    traj.phase = "BrakeToReverse";
else
    traj.phase = "Track";
end
end

function [theta_ffd, dtheta_ffd, scale, theta_max, k_l, gate_latched] = ...
    local_leg_swing_ffd(theta_ffd, height, traj, curr_dpos, p, dt, geom, fw, gate_latched)
% chassis.cpp:989 calcLegSwingFfd
theta_max_leg = fw.theta_max(height);
[scale, gate_latched] = local_demand_scale(traj.requested_vel, curr_dpos, p, gate_latched);
theta_max = theta_max_leg * scale;

% 前馈目标角。两种模型：
%   'firmware' = 固件现在的做法，线性 k(l)*a，k 由 chassis.hpp 的简化式给
%   'exact'    = 用 ffd_geom 的精确质心模型直接求"要 a 就得摆多少度"，
%                含腿质心贡献、h 与 l 的区分、静态质心偏置，不做线性化
if strcmp(p.FfdModel, 'exact')
    th_want = geom.theta_req(height, traj.acc_cmd);
    if p.kFfdSubtractStatic
        % 静态平衡角由 theta_trim_ 负责，前馈只出"因加速而多要的那部分"
        th_want = th_want - geom.theta_static(height);
    end
    % 等效 k 只为记录/判据用
    if abs(traj.acc_cmd) > 1e-6
        k_l = th_want / traj.acc_cmd;
    else
        k_l = geom.k_lin(height);
    end
    th_want = th_want * p.kThetaFfdCalibScaleExact;
else
    k_l = fw.k(height);
    th_want = k_l * traj.acc_cmd;
end

if theta_max <= 1e-4
    theta_ffd = local_lim_diff(0, theta_ffd, p.kPitchMaxDAng, dt);
    dtheta_ffd = 0;
    return;
end

target = min(max(th_want, -theta_max), theta_max);
tau = max(fw.tau(height), dt);
alpha = dt / tau;
err = target - theta_ffd;
theta_ffd = theta_ffd + alpha * err;
theta_ffd = min(max(theta_ffd, -theta_max), theta_max);
dtheta_ffd = err / tau;
end

function u = local_lqr_out(K, Ud, ref, X, p)
% lqrcontrol.cpp:596 calcLQROut，gain 全 1 (Mature/Ctrl)
d = ref - X;
for i = 1:4
    d(i) = min(max(d(i), -p.kLQRMaxError(i)), p.kLQRMaxError(i));
end
u = K * d + Ud;
end

% ================================================================ 指标

function out = local_pack(L, scen, p, plant, fell)
out = struct();
out.name = scen.name;
out.log = L;
out.fell = fell;
out.height = scen.height;
out.k_source = plant.k_source;
out.m = ffd_metrics(L, scen, p, fell);
end

% 定义力
syms f_l f_r             % 左右轮摩擦力
syms F_ws_l F_ws_r       % 左右腿对轮的水平作用力
syms F_wh_l F_wh_r       % 左右腿对轮的垂直作用力
syms F_bs_l F_bs_r       % 左右腿对身体的水平作用力           
syms F_bh_l F_bh_r       % 左右腿对身体的垂直作用力
% 定义力矩
syms T_wl_l T_wl_r       % 左右轮对腿的力矩
syms T_bl_l T_bl_r       % 左右腿对身体的力矩
% 定义质量，重心位置，转动惯量(对质心的转动惯量)
syms m_w m_l_l m_l_r m_b % 轮子、左右腿、身体的质量
syms R_w                 % 轮子半径
syms R_l                 % 髋关节距离/2
syms l_l l_r             % 左右腿的长度
syms l_w_l l_w_r         % 轮轴到腿质心的距离
syms l_b_l l_b_r         % 髋关节到腿质心的距离
syms l_c phi_c           % 机体质心位置和倾斜角（前倾为正）
syms I_w I_l_l I_l_r I_b % 轮子、左右腿、身体的转动惯量
syms I_zz                % 机体绕垂直轴的转动惯量（用于航向角动力学方程）

% 定义运动学变量(前倾为正)
syms theta_w_l dtheta_w_l ddtheta_w_l % 左轮转角及其一阶、二阶导数
syms theta_w_r dtheta_w_r ddtheta_w_r % 右轮转角及其一阶、二阶导数
syms theta_l_l dtheta_l_l ddtheta_l_l % 左腿转角及其一阶、二阶导数
syms theta_l_r dtheta_l_r ddtheta_l_r % 右腿转角及其一阶、二阶导数
syms theta_b dtheta_b ddtheta_b       % 机体倾斜角及其一阶、二阶导数
% 定义中间变量
syms s ds dd_s                       % 轮轴连线中点水平位移及其一阶、二阶导数
syms phi dphi ddphi                   % 航向角及其一阶、二阶导数
syms S_b dS_b ddS_b                 % 机体水平位移及其一阶、二阶导数
syms h_b dh_b ddh_b                 % 机体垂直绝对高度及其一阶、二阶导数
syms S_l_l dS_l_l ddS_l_l         % 左腿水平位移及其一阶、二阶导数
syms S_l_r dS_l_r ddS_l_r         % 右腿水平位移及其一阶、二阶导数
syms h_l_l dh_l_l ddh_l_l         % 左腿垂直绝对高度及其一阶、二阶导数
syms h_l_r dh_l_r ddh_l_r         % 右腿垂直绝对高度及其一阶、二阶导数
syms phi_w_l phi_w_r phi_b_l phi_b_r         % 腿质心位置与轮轴、髋关节的夹角
syms g                                       % 重力加速度

% ==================== 运动学 ====================
% 腿质心位置与轮轴、髋关节的夹角
phi_w_l = acos((l_w_l^2 + l_l^2 - l_b_l^2)/(2*l_w_l*l_l));
phi_w_r = acos((l_w_r^2 + l_r^2 - l_b_r^2)/(2*l_w_r*l_r));
phi_b_l = acos((l_b_l^2 + l_l^2 - l_w_l^2)/(2*l_b_l*l_l));
phi_b_r = acos((l_b_r^2 + l_r^2 - l_w_r^2)/(2*l_b_r*l_r));

% (4) 航向角 phi 及其一阶、二阶导数
phi = -R_w/(2*R_l)*(theta_w_l - theta_w_r) + 1/(2*R_l)*(-l_l*sin(theta_l_l) + l_r*sin(theta_l_r));
dphi = -R_w/(2*R_l)*(dtheta_w_l - dtheta_w_r) - l_l/(2*R_l)*cos(theta_l_l)*dtheta_l_l + l_r/(2*R_l)*cos(theta_l_r)*dtheta_l_r;
ddphi = -R_w/(2*R_l)*(ddtheta_w_l - ddtheta_w_r) - l_l/(2*R_l)*cos(theta_l_l)*ddtheta_l_l + l_r/(2*R_l)*cos(theta_l_r)*ddtheta_l_r ...
        + l_l/(2*R_l)*sin(theta_l_l)*dtheta_l_l^2 - l_r/(2*R_l)*sin(theta_l_r)*dtheta_l_r^2;

% (5) 身体水平位移 S_b 及其一阶、二阶导数
S_b = R_w/2*(theta_w_l + theta_w_r) + 1/2*(l_l*sin(theta_l_l) + l_r*sin(theta_l_r)) + l_c*sin(theta_b + phi_c);
dS_b = R_w/2*(dtheta_w_l + dtheta_w_r) + l_l/2*cos(theta_l_l)*dtheta_l_l + l_r/2*cos(theta_l_r)*dtheta_l_r + l_c*cos(theta_b + phi_c)*dtheta_b;
ddS_b = R_w/2*(ddtheta_w_l + ddtheta_w_r) + l_l/2*cos(theta_l_l)*ddtheta_l_l + l_r/2*cos(theta_l_r)*ddtheta_l_r ...
        - l_l/2*sin(theta_l_l)*dtheta_l_l^2 - l_r/2*sin(theta_l_r)*dtheta_l_r^2 - l_c*sin(theta_b + phi_c)*dtheta_b^2 + l_c*cos(theta_b + phi_c)*ddtheta_b;

% (6) 身体垂直绝对高度 h_b 及其一阶、二阶导数
h_b = 1/2*(l_l*cos(theta_l_l) + l_r*cos(theta_l_r)) + l_c*cos(theta_b + phi_c);
dh_b = -l_l/2*sin(theta_l_l)*dtheta_l_l - l_r/2*sin(theta_l_r)*dtheta_l_r - l_c*sin(theta_b + phi_c)*dtheta_b;
ddh_b = -l_l/2*sin(theta_l_l)*ddtheta_l_l - l_r/2*sin(theta_l_r)*ddtheta_l_r - l_l/2*cos(theta_l_l)*dtheta_l_l^2 ...
        - l_r/2*cos(theta_l_r)*dtheta_l_r^2 - l_c*cos(theta_b + phi_c)*dtheta_b^2 - l_c*sin(theta_b + phi_c)*ddtheta_b;

% (7) 腿部水平位移 S_l_i 及其一阶、二阶导数 (基于左右侧拆分)
S_l_l = R_w*theta_w_l + l_w_l*sin(theta_l_l - phi_w_l);
S_l_r = R_w*theta_w_r + l_w_r*sin(theta_l_r - phi_w_r);
dS_l_l = R_w*dtheta_w_l + l_w_l*cos(theta_l_l - phi_w_l)*dtheta_l_l;
dS_l_r = R_w*dtheta_w_r + l_w_r*cos(theta_l_r - phi_w_r)*dtheta_l_r;
ddS_l_l = R_w*ddtheta_w_l + l_w_l*cos(theta_l_l - phi_w_l)*ddtheta_l_l - l_w_l*sin(theta_l_l - phi_w_l)*dtheta_l_l^2;
ddS_l_r = R_w*ddtheta_w_r + l_w_r*cos(theta_l_r - phi_w_r)*ddtheta_l_r - l_w_r*sin(theta_l_r - phi_w_r)*dtheta_l_r^2;

% (8) 腿部垂直绝对高度 h_l_i 及其一阶、二阶导数 (基于左右侧拆分)
h_l_l = h_b - l_b_l*cos(theta_l_l + phi_b_l) - l_c*cos(theta_b + phi_c);
h_l_r = h_b - l_b_r*cos(theta_l_r + phi_b_r) - l_c*cos(theta_b + phi_c);
dh_l_l = dh_b + l_b_l*sin(theta_l_l + phi_b_l)*dtheta_l_l + l_c*sin(theta_b + phi_c)*dtheta_b;
dh_l_r = dh_b + l_b_r*sin(theta_l_r + phi_b_r)*dtheta_l_r + l_c*sin(theta_b + phi_c)*dtheta_b;
ddh_l_l = ddh_b + l_b_l*sin(theta_l_l + phi_b_l)*ddtheta_l_l + l_b_l*cos(theta_l_l + phi_b_l)*dtheta_l_l^2 ...
        + l_c*sin(theta_b + phi_c)*ddtheta_b + l_c*cos(theta_b + phi_c)*dtheta_b^2;
ddh_l_r = ddh_b + l_b_r*sin(theta_l_r + phi_b_r)*ddtheta_l_r + l_b_r*cos(theta_l_r + phi_b_r)*dtheta_l_r^2 ...
        + l_c*sin(theta_b + phi_c)*ddtheta_b + l_c*cos(theta_b + phi_c)*dtheta_b^2;

% (9) 轮轴连线中点水平位移 s 及其一阶、二阶导数
s = R_w/2*(theta_w_l + theta_w_r);
ds = R_w/2*(dtheta_w_l + dtheta_w_r);
dd_s = R_w/2*(ddtheta_w_l + ddtheta_w_r);

% ==================== 动力学 ====================

% 1. 轮 (Wheel)
% (1) 轮平动方程 (基于左右侧拆分)
eq1 = m_w * R_w * ddtheta_w_l == f_l - F_ws_l;
eq2 = m_w * R_w * ddtheta_w_r == f_r - F_ws_r;

% (2) 轮转动方程 (基于左右侧拆分)
eq3 = I_w * ddtheta_w_l == T_wl_l - f_l * R_w;
eq4 = I_w * ddtheta_w_r == T_wl_r - f_r * R_w;

% 2. 腿 (Leg)
% (3) 腿水平平动方程 (基于左右侧拆分)
eq5 = m_l_l * ddS_l_l == F_ws_l - F_bs_l;
eq6 = m_l_r * ddS_l_r == F_ws_r - F_bs_r;

% (4) 腿垂直平动方程 (基于左右侧拆分)
eq7 = m_l_l * ddh_l_l == F_wh_l - F_bh_l - m_l_l * g;
eq8 = m_l_r * ddh_l_r == F_wh_r - F_bh_r - m_l_r * g;

% (5) 腿转动方程 (基于左右侧拆分)
eq9 = I_l_l * ddtheta_l_l == F_wh_l*l_w_l*sin(theta_l_l - phi_w_l) - F_ws_l*l_w_l*cos(theta_l_l - phi_w_l) +...
                             F_bh_l*l_b_l*sin(theta_l_l + phi_b_l) - F_bs_l*l_b_l*cos(theta_l_l + phi_b_l) - T_wl_l + T_bl_l;
eq10 = I_l_r * ddtheta_l_r == F_wh_r*l_w_r*sin(theta_l_r - phi_w_r) - F_ws_r*l_w_r*cos(theta_l_r - phi_w_r) +...
                              F_bh_r*l_b_r*sin(theta_l_r + phi_b_r) - F_bs_r*l_b_r*cos(theta_l_r + phi_b_r) - T_wl_r + T_bl_r;

% 3. 机体 (Body)
% (6) 机体水平平动方程
eq11 = m_b * ddS_b == F_bs_l + F_bs_r;

% (7) 机体垂直平动方程
eq12 = m_b * ddh_b == F_bh_l + F_bh_r - m_b * g;

% (8)  机体转动方程
eq13 = I_b * ddtheta_b == -(T_bl_l + T_bl_r) - (F_bs_l + F_bs_r)*l_c*cos(theta_b + phi_c) + (F_bh_l + F_bh_r)*l_c*sin(theta_b + phi_c);

% 4. 旋转 (Rotation/Yaw)
% (9) 航向角动力学方程
eq14 = I_zz * ddphi == (-f_l + f_r)*R_l;

% 5. 支持力关系
% (10)
eq15 = F_wh_l == F_wh_r;


elim_vars = [f_l f_r F_ws_l F_ws_r F_wh_l F_wh_r F_bs_l F_bs_r F_bh_l F_bh_r];

elim_eqs = [eq1, eq2, eq3, eq4, eq5, eq6, eq7, eq8, eq12, eq15];

elim_solve = solve(elim_eqs, elim_vars);

eq_sub = subs([eq9, eq10, eq11, eq13, eq14], elim_vars, [elim_solve.f_l, elim_solve.f_r, elim_solve.F_ws_l, elim_solve.F_ws_r, ...
    elim_solve.F_wh_l, elim_solve.F_wh_r, elim_solve.F_bs_l, elim_solve.F_bs_r, elim_solve.F_bh_l, elim_solve.F_bh_r]);

% ==================== 小角度近似与线性化 ====================
% 目标形式：A_orig * ddTheta = B_u * U + B_x * X_sub + B_offset

% 1) 定义向量
ddTheta = [ddtheta_w_l; ddtheta_w_r; ddtheta_l_l; ddtheta_l_r; ddtheta_b];
U = [T_wl_l; T_wl_r; T_bl_l; T_bl_r];
X_sub = [theta_l_l; theta_l_r; theta_b];

% 2) 将方程写成残差形式 F = 0
F = lhs(eq_sub(:)) - rhs(eq_sub(:));

% 3) 以偏置点(零角度、零角速度、零输入、零加速度)做一阶泰勒线性化
aux_vars = [dtheta_w_l; dtheta_w_r; dtheta_l_l; dtheta_l_r; dtheta_b];
Z = [ddTheta; U; X_sub; aux_vars];
Z0 = sym(zeros(size(Z)));

F0 = subs(F, Z, Z0);
J0 = subs(jacobian(F, Z), Z, Z0);
F_lin = simplify(F0 + J0 * (Z - Z0));

% 4) 仅保留题设需要的变量组(忽略角速度项)
F_lin_sub = simplify(subs(F_lin, aux_vars, sym(zeros(size(aux_vars)))));

% 5) 提取矩阵项（先得到左侧形式：A*ddTheta + Bu_l*U + Bx_l*X_sub + c_l = 0）
A_orig = simplify(jacobian(F_lin_sub, ddTheta));
Bu_l = simplify(jacobian(F_lin_sub, U));
Bx_l = simplify(jacobian(F_lin_sub, X_sub));

zero_dd = sym(zeros(size(ddTheta)));
zero_u = sym(zeros(size(U)));
zero_x = sym(zeros(size(X_sub)));
c_l = simplify(subs(F_lin_sub, [ddTheta; U; X_sub], [zero_dd; zero_u; zero_x]));

% 6) 转换为题设形式：A_orig*ddTheta = B_u*U + B_x*X_sub + B_offset
B_u = simplify(-Bu_l);
B_x = simplify(-Bx_l);
B_offset = simplify(-c_l);

% 腿质心位于腿上且机体质心位于腿间时的特殊情况验证
test_A_orig = simplify(subs(A_orig, [phi_c, l_b_r, l_b_l], [0, l_r-l_w_r, l_l-l_w_l]));
test_B_u = simplify(subs(B_u, [phi_c, l_b_r, l_b_l], [0, l_r-l_w_r, l_l-l_w_l]));
test_B_x = simplify(subs(B_x, [phi_c, l_b_r, l_b_l], [0, l_r-l_w_r, l_l-l_w_l]));
test_B_offset = simplify(subs(B_offset, [phi_c, l_b_r, l_b_l], [0, l_r-l_w_r, l_l-l_w_l]));

%% 左右腿长度二维扫描下的 A_L, B_L 计算

%% 1) 载入静态参数与符号模型

	mkdir(data_dir);

	mkdir(output_dir);

%% 4) 预分配结果容器（二维腿长网格）
% 维度定义：A_L_grid(:,:,i,j) 对应 h_l = h_ls(i), h_r = h_ls(j)
A_L_grid = zeros(10,10,N,N);
B_L_grid = zeros(10,4,N,N);

U_d_grid = nan(4,N,N);

P_grid = nan(10,10,N,N);

%% 5) 左右腿长度二重 for 循环扫描
for i = 1:N
	h_l = h_ls(i);
	for j = 1:N
		h_r = h_ls(j);

		l_w_l_k = polyval(p_lw, h_l);
		l_b_l_k = polyval(p_lb, h_l);
		I_l_l_k = polyval(p_Ileg, h_l);

		l_w_r_k = polyval(p_lw, h_r);
		l_b_r_k = polyval(p_lb, h_r);
		I_l_r_k = polyval(p_Ileg, h_r);

		num_vals = [g_val, R_w_val, R_l_val, h_l, h_r, l_w_l_k, l_w_r_k, l_b_l_k, l_b_r_k, l_c_val, phi_c_val, ...
					m_w_val, m_l_l_val, m_l_r_val, m_b_val, I_w_val, I_l_l_k, I_l_r_k, I_b_val, I_zz_val];

		A_orig_num = double(vpa(subs(A_orig, sym_vars, num_vals)));
		B_u_num = double(vpa(subs(B_u, sym_vars, num_vals)));
		B_x_num = double(vpa(subs(B_x, sym_vars, num_vals)));
		B_offset_num = double(vpa(subs(B_offset, sym_vars, num_vals)));
		T_acc_num = double(vpa(subs(T_acc_eq, sym_vars, num_vals)));

		% 静态平衡前馈 U_d（最小二乘法代入动力学方程）
		% B_u * U_d + B_offset = 0
		% B_u 为 5x4 超定系统，直接最小二乘求解
		% 注：偏航方程自然蕴含 T_wl_l = T_wl_r，无需额外约束
		U_d_k = B_u_num \ (-B_offset_num);
		U_d_grid(:,i,j) = U_d_k;

		Ainv_Bu_num = A_orig_num \ B_u_num;
		Ainv_Bx_num = A_orig_num \ B_x_num;

		A_acc_num = T_acc_num * Ainv_Bx_num * E_sub;
		B_acc_num = T_acc_num * Ainv_Bu_num;

		A_k = zeros(10,10);
		B_k = zeros(10,4);

		A_k(1,2) = 1;
		A_k(3,4) = 1;
		A_k(5,6) = 1;
		A_k(7,8) = 1;
		A_k(9,10) = 1;

		A_k(2,:) = A_acc_num(1,:);
		A_k(4,:) = A_acc_num(2,:);
		A_k(6,:) = A_acc_num(3,:);
		A_k(8,:) = A_acc_num(4,:);
		A_k(10,:) = A_acc_num(5,:);

		B_k(2,:) = B_acc_num(1,:);
		B_k(4,:) = B_acc_num(2,:);
		B_k(6,:) = B_acc_num(3,:);
		B_k(8,:) = B_acc_num(4,:);
		B_k(10,:) = B_acc_num(5,:);

		A_L_grid(:,:,i,j) = A_k;
		B_L_grid(:,:,i,j) = B_k;

		% 连续系统离散化
		sys_c = ss(A_k, B_k, eye(10), zeros(10,4));
		sys_d = c2d(sys_c, Ts_val);
		A_d_k = sys_d.A;
		B_d_k = sys_d.B;

		A_d_grid(:,:,i,j) = A_d_k;
		B_d_grid(:,:,i,j) = B_d_k;

		% 基于 Q, R 的离散 LQR 增益
		try
			[K_k, P_k] = dlqr(A_d_k, B_d_k, Q, R);
			K_grid(:,:,i,j) = K_k;
			P_grid(:,:,i,j) = P_k;
		catch
			% 某些工况不可解时保留 NaN
            K_grid(:,:,i,j) = nan(4,10);
            P_grid(:,:,i,j) = nan(10,10);
            disp(['LQR 不可解: h_l = ', num2str(h_l), ' m, h_r = ', num2str(h_r), ' m']);
		end
	end
end

%% 数值线性化版 LQR 状态空间构造
% 目标：避免符号解析解，直接代入参数进行数值求解
% 输出：A_L_num, B_L_num, U_d_num, A_orig_num, B_u_num, B_x_num, B_offset_num

%% 1) 载入参数
run('param.m');

% 运行符号推导脚本，得到 A_orig, B_u, B_x, B_offset
run('equation.m');

p = struct();
p.g = g_val;
p.R_w = R_w_val;
p.R_l = R_l_val;
p.l_l = l_l_val;
p.l_r = l_r_val;
p.l_w_l = l_w_l_val;
p.l_w_r = l_w_r_val;
p.l_b_l = l_b_l_val;
p.l_b_r = l_b_r_val;
p.l_c = l_c_val;
p.phi_c = phi_c_val;
p.m_w = m_w_val;
p.m_l_l = m_l_l_val;
p.m_l_r = m_l_r_val;
p.m_b = m_b_val;
p.I_w = I_w_val;
p.I_l_l = I_l_l_val;
p.I_l_r = I_l_r_val;
p.I_b = I_b_val;
p.I_zz = I_zz_val;

% 几何夹角（常值）
p.phi_w_l = acos((p.l_w_l^2 + p.l_l^2 - p.l_b_l^2) / (2 * p.l_w_l * p.l_l));
p.phi_w_r = acos((p.l_w_r^2 + p.l_r^2 - p.l_b_r^2) / (2 * p.l_w_r * p.l_r));
p.phi_b_l = acos((p.l_b_l^2 + p.l_l^2 - p.l_w_l^2) / (2 * p.l_b_l * p.l_l));
p.phi_b_r = acos((p.l_b_r^2 + p.l_r^2 - p.l_w_r^2) / (2 * p.l_b_r * p.l_r));

%% 2) 线性化点
% 状态子向量 X_sub = [theta_l_l; theta_l_r; theta_b]
X0 = zeros(3,1);
U0 = zeros(4,1);
DD0 = zeros(5,1);   % ddTheta = [ddtheta_w_l; ddtheta_w_r; ddtheta_l_l; ddtheta_l_r; ddtheta_b]

%% 3) 直接由 equation.m 的解析矩阵代入参数，得到数值矩阵
sym_vars = [g, R_w, R_l, l_l, l_r, l_w_l, l_w_r, l_b_l, l_b_r, l_c, phi_c, ...
            m_w, m_l_l, m_l_r, m_b, I_w, I_l_l, I_l_r, I_b, I_zz];
num_vals = [g_val, R_w_val, R_l_val, l_l_val, l_r_val, l_w_l_val, l_w_r_val, l_b_l_val, l_b_r_val, l_c_val, phi_c_val, ...
            m_w_val, m_l_l_val, m_l_r_val, m_b_val, I_w_val, I_l_l_val, I_l_r_val, I_b_val, I_zz_val];

A_orig_num = double(vpa(subs(A_orig, sym_vars, num_vals)));
B_u_num = double(vpa(subs(B_u, sym_vars, num_vals)));
B_x_num = double(vpa(subs(B_x, sym_vars, num_vals)));
B_offset_num = double(vpa(subs(B_offset, sym_vars, num_vals)));

%% 4) 静态平衡前馈 U_d（最小二乘法代入动力学方程）
% B_u * U_d + B_offset = 0
% B_u 为 5x4 超定系统，直接最小二乘求解
% 注：偏航方程自然蕴含 T_wl_l = T_wl_r，无需额外约束
U_d_num = B_u_num \ (-B_offset_num);

%% 5) 数值方式得到 T_acc（由加速度映射对 ddTheta 求雅各比）
ddX_acc_expr = [dd_s; ddphi; ddtheta_l_l; ddtheta_l_r; ddtheta_b];
T_acc_sym = jacobian(ddX_acc_expr, ddTheta);
T_acc_eq = subs(T_acc_sym, [theta_l_l, theta_l_r, dtheta_l_l, dtheta_l_r], [0, 0, 0, 0]);
T_acc_num = double(vpa(subs(T_acc_eq, sym_vars, num_vals)));

%% 6) 组装十阶状态空间 A_L, B_L
% ddTheta = A_orig^{-1}(B_u*u + B_x*X_sub)
Ainv_Bu_num = A_orig_num \ B_u_num;
Ainv_Bx_num = A_orig_num \ B_x_num;

% X_sub = E_sub * X
E_sub = zeros(3,10);
E_sub(1,5) = 1;
E_sub(2,7) = 1;
E_sub(3,9) = 1;

A_acc_num = T_acc_num * Ainv_Bx_num * E_sub;   % 5x10
B_acc_num = T_acc_num * Ainv_Bu_num;           % 5x4

A_L_num = zeros(10,10);
B_L_num = zeros(10,4);

% 一阶积分关系
A_L_num(1,2) = 1;
A_L_num(3,4) = 1;
A_L_num(5,6) = 1;
A_L_num(7,8) = 1;
A_L_num(9,10) = 1;

% 偶数行填加速度方程
A_L_num(2,:)  = A_acc_num(1,:);
A_L_num(4,:)  = A_acc_num(2,:);
A_L_num(6,:)  = A_acc_num(3,:);
A_L_num(8,:)  = A_acc_num(4,:);
A_L_num(10,:) = A_acc_num(5,:);

B_L_num(2,:)  = B_acc_num(1,:);
B_L_num(4,:)  = B_acc_num(2,:);
B_L_num(6,:)  = B_acc_num(3,:);
B_L_num(8,:)  = B_acc_num(4,:);
B_L_num(10,:) = B_acc_num(5,:);

%% 7) 离散化（按 Ts）
sys_c = ss(A_L_num, B_L_num, eye(10), zeros(10,4));
sys_d = c2d(sys_c, Ts_val);
A_d_num = sys_d.A;
